notes.title: Your questions for the devs? Here are the answers!
notes.content:
[p]Hey!  

It took some time, but we've answered as many questions as we could. 

 [/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth="344,343"][tr][th colwidth="344"][p]Question[/p][/th][th colwidth="343"][p]Answer[/p][/th][/tr][tr][th colwidth="344"][p]Will there be more classes being released over time?[/p][/th][td colwidth="343"][p][b]Martin[/b]: We have several ideas for new classes and new heroes. We're evaluating potential implementation and roadmap together with our publisher.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][th colwidth="344"][p]Are new units on the horizon? Would love to see some more siege type units to help bring variety to the towers/ballistae everywhere.[/p][/th][td colwidth="343"][p][b]Martin[/b]: We definitely like the idea of having siege-type units that could be used both for defense and for attacking camps (which would also have improved defenses and wouldn’t be easy to destroy with regular units). However, we’re not planning these changes in the near future..[/p][/td][/tr][tr][th colwidth="344"][p]This one is very important. What's your favorite kind of sandwich?[/p][/th][td colwidth="343"][p][b]Lukas[/b]: Definitely none from Subway (Sorry!)
[b]Ondrej[/b]: A free sandwich
[b]Martin[/b]: Tuna and egg sandwich
[b]Tadeas[/b]: I don't eat carbs, only to drink them later on
[b]Jakub[/b]: Club sandwich
[b]David[/b]: Sahib’s Dream[/p][/td][/tr][tr][th colwidth="344"][p]What's your favourite kind of ice cream?[/p][/th][td colwidth="343"][p][b]Lukas[/b]: Mojito flavour (non alcoholic ofc!)
[b]Ondrej[/b]: Does ‘yes’ count as a flavor?
[b]Martin[/b]: Lemon in bananas in chocolate 🙂
[b]Tadeas[/b]: Vanilla
[b]Jakub[/b]: Mango ice cream
[b]David[/b]: Magnum Double Caramel[/p][/td][/tr][tr][th colwidth="344"][p]What is the favorite hero of each member of the team?[/p][/th][td colwidth="343"][p][b]Lukas[/b]: Paladin, brings some nostalgic feeling from vanilla wow.
[b]Ondrej[/b]: Eldrin, because life’s too short to run up and hit things
[b]Martin[/b]: Ardan (because he was our first Hero and also has a very nice model) + Garnet (because he's red-haired like me)
[b]Tadeas[/b]: Nariel just because hasn't been nerfed ever since 😈
[b]Jakub[/b]: Garnet
[b]David[/b]: Nariel[/p][/td][/tr][tr][th colwidth="344"][p]About the campaign from a tester, how far did campaign testing phase (me as an example) came compared when each mission was first made?, or in general how long did it take to make each mission.[/p][/th][td colwidth="343"][p][b]Ondrej[/b]: Each mission took roughly one to two months to go from a top-down sketch on a whiteboard to a fully playable version in the game. After that, we entered the testing phase, where we iterated based on feedback from multiple tester groups. We intentionally rotated testers between iterations to ensure that feedback reflected a fresh perspective, not prior familiarity with the mission.

While the content of the missions didn't change drastically during these iterations, testers were invaluable in identifying bugs and helping us fine-tune elements like pacing, difficulty, and clarity. In some cases, they missed certain areas altogether, which told us we needed to make those sections more noticeable.

Overall, the testing process played a huge role in shaping the final experience. It helped us spot design elements that weren't working as intended and ultimately made the game more intuitive and enjoyable.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][th colwidth="344"][p]You mentioned back then that you came up with original designs to later finding out that they were already present in WC3 & were thus scrapped. Could you mention the Warcraft mission names that were close to your design for us to speculate how would the mission play in Darfall (yeah last time I forgot to add this part :D).[/p][/th][td colwidth="343"][p][b]Lukas[/b]: I no longer remember the scrapped ones (as the ideas were halted quite soon before any implementation) But for similar ones, The Defense of Strahnbrad was an issue. They introduce main hero (Arthas), then also second hero (Uther), mission is a tutorial and they fight orcs. Our first mission we also need to introduce our hero (Eldrin), introduce other character (Captain Thorne), have it as a tutorial, as well as fight orcs. Trying quite hard, it still looks very same, even though we could not cut/change almost anything without completly changing our campaign structure and lore.
The Culling of Stratholm was inspiration and still is very close to our mission “Mistfen’s last Hour”, (but you evacuate instead of cull citizens) while the last mission is also quite close to Mount Hyjal, but you invade the demons, instead of being invaded.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][th colwidth="344"][p]Are you considering to add some way to regrow trees on the map or at least manage wood a little better? Right now its the hardest resource to deal with and can get quite tedious depending on the biome. It also doesn't work very well with the long survival mode (or would simply make endless a lot more appealing)[/p][/th][td colwidth="343"][p][b]Martin[/b]: Even on maps with fewer trees, there are still enough wood to cover the required amount of resources. The real bottleneck in terms of progression is more often the mana orbs (during early game); food on certain maps (which can be managed by choosing the right strategy); but the most significant bottleneck is the hard cap on workers, which is set due to technical limitations on the number of entities in the game.

If someone is lacking wood, they need to build more woodcutters, either by expanding territory through lamps or by utilizing outposts.

We do recognize that more players are having trouble with wood, but that's mostly because our economy is set up differently than what players are typically used to. So we don’t rule out making some adjustments to bring it closer to player expectations.

As for tree regrowth itself, we’re not considering it at the moment.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][th colwidth="344"][p]Any plans for an optional/experimental settings to increase unit limits in survival? At the least - an option to do it for custom maps in the editor? Since you already have code for limiting units, I imagine it wouldn't take too much of dev time.[/p][/th][td colwidth="343"][p][b]Martin[/b]: The unit limit in Survival mode exists for several reasons. One of them is performance on weaker PCs. Having too many units could lead to FPS issues, especially during night invasions when there are dozens of entities on the map.
Another issue is that it's technically quite challenging to ensure units remain easy, responsive, and intuitive to control during battles. We've already released several updates focusing on this, but in general, the more units there are, the messier it gets and the more micromanagement is required.

Adding this limit to the editor is a good idea. It's been noted in the backlog.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][th colwidth="344"][p]Do you have any plans to further develop survival mode beyond what it is right now (in terms of content or mechanics, whatever they may be)?[/p][/th][td colwidth="343"][p][b]Martin[/b]: We have hundreds of notes recorded and are still in the phase of collecting feedback. Later on, we’ll organize and evaluate it. For now, we’re not planning any major changes, but we do like the idea of adding progression to the survival mode.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][th colwidth="344"][p]Will the new campaign assets be available in the editor as placabless or else? - they re awesome and I'd love to use them[/p][/th][td colwidth="343"][p][b]Lukas[/b]: all campaign assets are present in the editor, as we use the same editor/assets players have available for the public.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][th colwidth="344"][p]Would you consider making a necromancer like character?[/p][/th][td colwidth="343"][p][b]Martin[/b]: Yes, the Necromancer character is in our backlog, and we like the idea of making her a woman.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][th colwidth="344"][p]Will there be more survival maps? With how big the map is it really looks like there is room to grow.[/p][/th][td colwidth="343"][p][b]Martin[/b]: If new biomes were created (e.g. jungle, tundra, mountain), new maps would be added as well.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][th colwidth="344"][p](Q1) Will survival get any kind of earned progression? It just doesn't make sense to me that it is laid out the way it is but the heroes always have to start from 0.

(Q2) Will there more progression systems when playing the game? me and my friend complain a bit regarding that "there's no progression between maps", simple stuff such as passive skill points would make it more exciting for us ![/p][/th][td colwidth="343"][p][b]Martin[/b]: We’d really like to have some type of metalevel layer above the Survival mode, but the problem is that it would disrupt gameplay balance if a Hero started with some improved stats or equipment. That’s why we’re considering a metalevel system that would be separate from the game-level and in-level progression.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][th colwidth="344"][p]What are you bigger insparations when making Darfall? I'm sure most RTS vets can pick out the main ones but I'd like to hear if there any guiding philosophies you had that are similar to RTS games of the past![/p][/th][td colwidth="343"][p][b]Lukas[/b]: The Warcraft was the main one, mainly the visual thematic, races and combat. But “survive the nights” came directly from They Are Billions. And as there was no “wacraft 3 survive nights” game, we knew we had a chance! Not directly games, but the Warhammer universe and Game of Thrones had big influence on atmosphere, lore and continent composition (world map).

[b]Martin[/b]: I tried to look at Darfall with Don’t Starve in mind as a source of inspiration. You have a main character (both in Darfall and in Don’t Starve); you build your base (in both games); and you explore the world and gather items needed for base development (again, similar to Don’t Starve). Even though it’s a different genre, I still see a lot of similarities when it comes to base building and resource management :)[/p][/td][/tr][tr][th colwidth="344"][p]Are there any deep gameplay changes being talked about/in the works for expansions in future? AKA: Any micro / macro gameplay changes that could be coming down the pipeline? Or do you guys feel satisfied with the backbone and core gameplay loop that you have created?[/p][/th][td colwidth="343"][p][b]Martin[/b]: In general, the hardest thing in game development is prioritizing tasks and features. We have an incredibly long backlog that we’re constantly adding to, but choosing what’s truly important is very challenging, especially when there are only a few of us working on a project as big as Darfall. So, we're currently in a phase where we're still collecting feedback, which we'll evaluate later.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][th colwidth="344"][p]What was the timeline like for Darfalls creation? From idea inception to first character/level design untill current day? The game has a ton of visual polish that leads me to believe that development was a laborious process.[/p][/th][td colwidth="343"][p][b]Lukas[/b]: Darfall was actually started as 1 men project years back, as a “tower defense” game on islands with minecraft like graphics. Then I got addicted to They are Billions, and from that point, I knew what I wanted Darfall to be :) We were working on the game in just our spare time with Martin for the past few years, then the real production, with artists was little over a year, leading to full release.  
[b]Martin[/b]: To add to what Lukas said, I’ll try to be more specific in terms of the timeline. Hopefully I remember it correctly :)  

• [b]2019–2020[/b] - Lukas created the initial prototype of the voxel-based version
 • [b]Mid-2020[/b] - I started collaborating with Lukas (by the way, we know each other from a previous job)
• [b]End of 2020[/b] - I quit my job so I could, among other things, start working part-time on Darfall 
• [b]2021–2023[/b] - We continued working part/full-time on the project, just the two of us 
• [b]End of 2023[/b] - We signed a partnership with Paradox, and Lukas left his job 
• [b]2024[/b] - We began expanding the team with new members 
• [b]May 2024 - May 2025[/b] - Ongoing redesign of Darfall from a voxel-based style to low-poly textured graphics; completing the entire game[/p][/td][/tr][tr][th colwidth="344"][p](Q1) When will coop be added?

(Q2) Coop mode where multiple players build a base together

(Q3) Versus mode where players each have their own bases and waves to defend against and can spend resources or cast spells to strengthen the waves attacking enemy players[/p][/th][td colwidth="343"][p][b]Martin[/b]: Coop is technically very demanding; unfortunately, we do not plan it for now, even though we would also love to play together as a team or with/against friends.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][th colwidth="344"][p]dwarf faction, elven faction and orc faction would be great... also new heroes with this game style is a must. hoping to see a sword and shield style hero,[/p][/th][td colwidth="343"][p][b]Martin[/b]: All these suggestions are noted in the Backlog as ideas for further game improvements.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][th colwidth="344"][p]Wood gathering needs to be increased. I never have issues with anything other than wood every game, and on some maps depending on RNG, it's over before it begins due to wood.[/p][/th][td colwidth="343"][p][b]Lukas[/b]: Isn’t the wood comparable to gold from Warcraft or crystals from Starcraft? As its a main resource and used for everything, even in the mentioned games, the resource is always spent and in great demand, since its used for almost every purchase, thus the player needs to carefully plan, spend and expand to get more of it. Increasing the wood production would just allow you to spend it more faster, leading to the same result, not enough wood, just faster :)[/p][/td][/tr][tr][th colwidth="344"][p]When will Darfall support cloud saves?[/p][/th][td colwidth="343"][p][b]Ondrej[/b]: We do support cloud saves

[b]Martin[/b]: It was added a few weeks after the release.[/p][/td][/tr][/table]

notes.title: Artistic Improvements - What’s Next for Balance?
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Warriors![/h2][p]Here are the changes included in the new build, along with some additional updates about Darfall.[/p][h2]
🏔️ Mission 2 & 4 Mountains Rework[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/e3e67f3d9e9eff0895a6220f556ae3b570bf20a7.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We’ve redesigned the [b]mountain layouts in Mission 2 and Mission 4[/b]. With this update, [b]all mountains across the entire campaign[/b] now meet our intended improved quality level.[/p][p]Just to clarify, [b]the visual appearance of mountains in Survival Mode remains unchanged. [/b]Since Survival maps are [b]procedurally generated[/b], we can’t apply the same handcrafted techniques that Ondrej (our level designer) uses in the campaign, where each mountain is carefully placed with love, rock by rock.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Mission 2 Improvements (Before/After):[/b][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/fc003709c490f980803e6758ad518847933cbfd4.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/062eae5eb4966b6cb532fcf76ecd5d7360ed9311.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/c3118b5fa7e12e89033b40e9b4eaa4631cfbba18.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/9b54cf2d26f9b3c2a886d12ca602c15e18adff8f.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/6152b3bfd98ab697cdc57db881141c857bdd3d82.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/a7c045eb88e8a98c539bf783f0c179d2e0dadff7.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p][b]Mission 4 Improvements (Before/After):[/b][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/a46bad57a4f2ca93011723babae5ae6e905bee59.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/fb46e2bec589a337fcd180e7af2fd815fe33ecb2.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/482360ffa4b2278ccb302b964e26624f7ac31b4c.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/affa13bbf8af3bcf08b7e30e838471f9ced3ad4e.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/65828a999ce8cc4f78682e3d55d2efa437830438.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/eb7448723f3686cd138d2b0c9cd0d350518779f1.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][p][/p][h2]🎙️ No More AI Voices - Real Actors Only[/h2][p]Until now, we’ve been using 95% voice-overs recorded by real actors. As of this update, it’s 100% and that doesn’t just apply to voice-overs. The [b]Barracks Warriors[/b] now feature [b]brand-new recordings from real voice actor[/b], bringing more authenticity and personality to the game. The splash screen image shown during the game's initial loading has also been replaced with a concept artwork by Dalibor, our concept artist. With this, [b]Darfall is now completely free of AI-generated art and audio[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]🎵 Darfall Soundtrack Now on Spotify[/h2][p]Enjoy the haunting and atmospheric music of Darfall outside the game! Our composer [b]Robert Bruckmayer[/b] has published [b]Darfall soundtrack on Spotify[/b]. Just search for "Darfall" or check the following link: [url="https://open.spotify.com/album/1DPgxBUJDDTH1Cy4ZkfQeM?si=cLQfQrPwQwShpuQ94MuuDg"]Darfall on Spotify[/url]

Huge thanks also go to the other artists who contributed to composing the music for Darfall - Cosme Leites and Adam Barczi. In the future, we’d love to bring you the full soundtrack featuring music from all of these artists.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]💀 Reminder: Endless Mode & Difficulty Update[/h2][p]Don’t forget to check out the recently added [b]Endless Mode[/b], as well as the [b]rebalanced difficulty settings across all modes[/b]. Whether you're new or a veteran, you’ll notice tighter, more rewarding challenge curves.[/p][p]We’ve also introduced [b]two new difficulties[/b] - [b]Chaosborn[/b] (for those who want to suffer) and [b]Explorer[/b] (a more relaxed experience focused on the story and world).[/p][p]These changes were part of the [b]Monday update[/b]. For full patch notes and more details, check out our previous [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1961600/view/502826450314857339?l=english"]announcement[/url][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/4532961d0e2442587a1448762208eb170abdfe81.png"][/img][/p][h2]
🏆 New Achievements Available[/h2][p]Based on the new [b]Chaosborn difficulty,[/b] [b]we’ve added new achievements[/b] as well. Can you survive long enough to unlock them all? Don’t forget to share your high score on our Discord in the [url="https://discord.com/channels/826887508326613042/1066300509494976572"]#share-your-score[/url] channel!
[/p][p][/p][h2]⚖️ What’s Next for Balance?[/h2][p]Since the game’s release about a month ago, we’ve received a huge amount of feedback from you - a lot of it positive, but also plenty of constructive criticism, especially regarding [b]balance changes[/b].[/p][p]Please know, we read every piece of feedback, log it, and evaluate it thoroughly.[/p][p][b]If you have additional specific suggestions for balance improvements[/b], feel free to [b]share them with us[/b] on our [url="https://discord.gg/RvwFS85w4c"]Discord[/url] or right here in the discussion below. We really appreciate your input!


[b]Thanks & Have Fun![/b]
[b]Darfall Crew[/b][/p]

notes.title: Endless Mode / New Difficulties
notes.content:
[b]Hello warriors[/b],

We’re excited to announce the latest update, bringing new features, balance changes, and improvements that many of you have requested! Dive into the refreshed experience and get ready for tougher challenges.

[h3]What do we want to achieve with this update?[/h3]
[list]
[*] Add [b]more tension to night waves[/b], with larger and more challenging enemy attacks
[*] Make [b]raiding enemy camps during the day more difficult[/b]. At higher difficulties, your hero and a small squad will no longer be enough to conquer every camp
[*] Make defending your base and outposts during the day more challenging
[*] Tailor the difficulty options to your skill by [b]allowing you to choose from multiple difficulty levels[/b]
[*] On the other hand, for players who found the game too challenging, we’re introducing [b]the new Explorer difficulty[/b], offering a more forgiving experience
[/list]

[h2]Endless Mode[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/0cb4c201c4c0de67ed79ac8e84a1e200a728661d.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] Located in the Survival section
[*] Unlocked from the start for all biomes!
[*] In each round, try to outdo yourself and everyone else
[*] Sooner or later, the undead and demons will defeat you
[*] Share your achievements in the [url=https://discord.com/channels/826887508326613042/1066300509494976572]share-your-score[/url] channel on our [url=https://discord.gg/RvwFS85w4c]Discord[/url]


[/list]

[h2]New Difficulties[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/4532961d0e2442587a1448762208eb170abdfe81.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Choose from one of five difficulty levels, for both Survival and Campaign.
[*] If you prefer an easier path, Explorer is the right choice for you. If you already know the game mechanics and enjoy a high challenge, Chaosborn is the difficulty for you.
[*] Medium will no longer be as easy as before! You might even need to switch to Easy!
[/list]

[h2]Changelog Summary[/h2]

[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Survival: [b]Each biome[/b] now has its own [b]Endless Mode[/b]
[*] Added [b]two new difficulty levels: Explorer and Chaosborn[/b]
[/list]

[h3]Balance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Outposts now consume 1 Charcoal
[*] Survival: Adjusted [b]Night Waves[/b] based on difficulty
[*] Survival: Adjusted [b]Orc raids[/b]
[*] Survival: Adjusted [b]Daily Undead assaults[/b]
[/list]

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Campaign: [b]Enhanced environmental visuals in Mission 2[/b] - Passage into Doom
[*] [b]Added achievements[/b] for Campaign and Survival on Chaosborn difficulty
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Survival: Fixed an issue where achievements could trigger on the wrong difficulty
[*] Scenario Editor: Disabled mountain undo to prevent graphical glitches and performance problems
[/list]

[i]We appreciate your continued support and feedback. Please share your thoughts on our [url=https://discord.gg/RvwFS85w4c]Discord[/url] or in the discussion below to help us further improve the game![/i]


[b]To Battle![/b]

notes.title: PTR - Difficulty Adjustments Live
notes.content:
Hello everybody,

the [b]ptr-1[/b] Steam branch has now been updated with new balance adjustments and is ready for testing before the version goes live as the 1.1 update.

[h2]Difficulties Balance[/h2]

[h3]Chaosborn[/h3]  
[list]  
[*] Increased DMG and HP multiplier from 135% to 200%  
[*] Decreased score multiplier from 2.0 to 1.8  
[*] Reduced entity count multiplier in night waves  
[*] Enemy levels remain unchanged, so enemies at the edge of the map have the same strength
[/list]

[h3]Hard[/h3]  
[list]  
[*] Increased DMG and HP multiplier from 125% to 140%  
[*] Score multiplier remains at 1.5  
[*] Reduced entity count multiplier in night waves  
[*] Enemy levels remain unchanged, so enemies at the edge of the map have the same strength  
[/list]

[h3]Medium[/h3]  
[list]  
[*] DMG and HP multiplier remains at 100%  
[*] Score multiplier remains at 1.2  
[*] Entity count multiplier in night waves remains unchanged  
[*] Slightly increased enemy level  
[/list]

[h3]Easy[/h3]  
[list]  
[*] Increased DMG and HP multiplier from 50% to 60%  
[*] Score multiplier remains at 1.0  
[*] Entity count multiplier in night waves remains unchanged  
[*] Slightly increased enemy level  
[/list]

[h3]Explorer[/h3]  
[list]  
[*] DMG and HP multiplier remains at 30%  
[*] Score multiplier remains at 0.5  
[*] Entity count multiplier in night waves remains unchanged  
[*] Slightly increased enemy level  
[/list]

[b]Orc Raids have been adjusted:[/b] they now occur only once per day until Day 10, and twice per day afterward.


[i]Disclaimer: All values you see in-game for difficulties and enemy waves are subject to change during testing based on feedback.[/i]

We will continue adjusting the balance based on your input.

We would highly appreciate your feedback on our Discord, the best way is through [url=https://discord.com/channels/826887508326613042/1373215900530118687]PTR forum[/url], or directly in the announcement discussion below. Your input will help us balance the game the right way.


---

How to access the PTR version:
1. Right-click on Darfall in your Steam Library
2. Choose Properties
3. Go to the Betas tab
4. From the dropdown, select [b]ptr-1[/b] (this will trigger an update)
5. Click Play

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/450bdb28b820674feb31c5343ee4529151af242d.png[/img]

To return to the regular version, repeat the steps above but choose [b]None[/b] instead of [b]ptr-1[/b].

---

Thanks again for helping us test and fine-tune the experience. Good luck out there!

notes.title: PTR - Endless Mode and 2 New Difficulties
notes.content:
Hello everybody,

the [b]ptr-1[/b] steam branch has now been updated with new features and is ready for testing, before the version goes live as 1.1 update.

[h2]Endless Mode[/h2]

The "endless" mode is here! What it means?
[list][*] The survival world map now has 5 additional map points, 1 for each biome
[*] Playing on survival has no WIN condition and no final demonic wave
[*] You lose the game if you loose the keep
[*] You will eventually fall, as each night, the difficulty and number of enemies increase. 
[*] Now its about: How far you can get?[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/58893d102509bac58919934667d5e623bcbb2974.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Difficulties[/h2]
[h3]Explorer[/h3]
The easiest difficulty bellow Easy. It is designed for players who want to explore the map and build without much challenge.

[list]
[*] Less enemies during the nights
[*] Enemies on map have lower levels
[/list]

[h3]Chaosborn[/h3]

notes.title: Plans for 1.1 and Beyond
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings[/h1]

First of all, thank you for playing Darfall.

It has been four days since launch, and the amount of feedback, bug reports, and suggestions from the community has been incredible. We're reading every message, review, and every forum post, and we truly appreciate all of it.

Several topics have come up repeatedly, including:  
[list]  
[*]Controls  
[*]Economy  
[*]Difficulty  
[*]Endless mode  
[/list]

We want you to know that we hear you, and we're actively working to address these areas. Below is an overview of what’s already been changed and what’s coming next.

[h2]Recently Added (based on your feedback):[/h2]  
[list]  
[*]Holding Shift while using rectangle selection now adds new units to your selection  
[*]Holding Shift and right-clicking a unit’s portrait will now remove it from your current selection  
[/list]

[h2]Upcoming Improvements (being tested and finalized):[/h2]

[b]Controls[/b]  
[list]  
[*]Shift + Number will add selected units to an existing control group
[*]Selecting units in battle, left clicking your unit will have higher priority then selecting an enemy. This should prevent you accidentally selecting enemy, if you just want to run away with an injured unit  
[*]Rectangle selection will select units based on their full model, not just their pivot point
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/5988b35f79013c70a501cb55d4b7237bbe2fe6e7.jpg[/img]

[b]Difficulty[/b]  
[list]  
[*]Demon portal camps will be slightly nerfed to stay challenging but fair  
[*]Final waves in 7-day and 10-day maps will be stronger to better match late-game scaling  
[*]We are considering adding a difficulty below Easy and one above Hard  
[/list]

[b]AI Behavior[/b]  
[list]  
[*]Enemies will now consider switching targets if their current one runs away and they receive damage from other targets nearby
[*]When 1 of your player units attacks an enemy, it will signal nearby allied units to help him. This should prevent rest of your units just standing and watching
[/list]

[b]Endless Mode[/b]  
[list]  
[*]We are exploring dedicated endless maps for each biome, with infinite scaling and no final wave  
[*]This would let you fully test builds and push progression to the limit
[/list]

Among all of the above are of course dozens of fixes/improvements for various of issues. And of course, cloud saves! We have not forgotten :)

---

We’ll go into more detail for each change in individual patch notes as they release.

Lastly, thank you for your support. Darfall is a large and complex game with three main modes: [i]Survival[/i], [i]Campaign[/i], and the [i]Scenario Editor[/i]. Even small changes take time to test properly across all systems. A fix in one mode could break another, so we’re being careful to get it right.

Your support and feedback help us every step of the way. We're working hard every day to make Darfall better, and we’re excited for what’s ahead.

[b]Thank you again,[/b]  
[i]The SquareNite Team[/i]

notes.title: DevBlog #24: A Visual Overhaul - Tale Of Mud, Stone, and Grit
notes.content:
Ah, wanderers of the realm – lend me your eyes, for the lands of Darfall are changing.

In preparation for release, we’ve reforged the very face of the world you’ll explore. Our artisans have been hard at work reshaping buildings, terrain, and even the heroes who tread these cursed soils - all to better capture the grim majesty of Darfall’s dark fantasy heart.

[h2]Architecture Reborn: Rougher, Heavier[/h2]
Gone are the clean-cut lines and polished shine of a fledgling world. The buildings and characters now bear the grime of survival - their textures weathered by time, ash, and war.

Walls now look like they’ve stood against countless undead sieges. Heroes wear armor scuffed and worn from battle, their cloaks dragging the dust behind them. These aren’t stylized dolls — they are warriors, survivors, engineers, and outcasts.

[b]Old Look[/b]:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/bc832698d055841a4f864af0511ee518242b89a3.jpg[/img]
[b]New Look[/b]:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/edb6ec7f9d9a601e50f4e299cfcb8fcf9bbabfc6.jpg[/img]
And when you gaze upon your settlement… you’ll feel it: Darfall is not a place of comfort. It is a place of defiance.

[b]Old Look[/b]:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/e359c37f14e5d1b642d4ae5ff600ed3ae86ff840.jpg[/img]
[b]New Look[/b]:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/6d3b328efac71a9bef962c87c79db0de0f7fd84d.jpg[/img]
[h2]Terrain Overhaul – Painting a Harsh World[/h2]
The land itself has grown wiser. We’ve revisited all terrain textures to make each environment feel more grounded, more tactile, and more befitting a world where demons stalk the forests and snow falls on forgotten graves.

[b]Old Look[/b]:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/c8dcd8533fafab3403c4ce176a56454d89ba6c3a.jpg[/img]
[b]New Look[/b]:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/1869bbc445f89ecca6a9849c11ac8653e80dd4fd.jpg[/img]
[list][*] Grass no longer glows like a children’s tale - it now crunches beneath boots, coarse and real.
[*] Dirt paths are muddier, cracked, and true to their biomes.
[*] Snow doesn’t rest softly anymore - it presses, weighs, and reminds you that warmth is a luxury.[/list]
[b]Old Look[/b]:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/cce38fe73c1bcb4f61c37945ce7d52fd9b08b02f.jpg[/img]
[b]New Look[/b]:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/2f765d35a50f638fd9bb75070d410f6d3c7f7ca4.jpg[/img]
[h2]Environmental Details[/h2]
It’s not just the mountains and rivers that shape a land, but the little things.

We’re weaving in environmental storytelling through new props and details, like:
[list][*] Moss-covered stumps in the swamps
[*] Frozen lilies in the highlands
[*] Sunken boats in murky waters
[*] Mushrooms, rocks, and logs hinting at a forgotten past
[*] Each zone now feels like it has a history — quiet, buried, waiting to be uncovered.[/list]

[h2]Performance First[/h2]
You might be wondering: “What about performance?”

Every visual change has been built with optimization in mind. These updates are not just for looks - they’re built to run better, not worse.

Expect smoother performance and higher fidelity. No trade-offs here - your armies will march, your hammers will fall, and your frames will hold.

[h2]A Glimpse Into the Swamp and Winter[/h2]
Below are a few early shots from our Swamp and Winter biome overhauls. Pay attention to the color grading, the layering, and how it all comes together into a world that feels bleak, real, and alive.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/59a62422ef410318c03b9e06e68d950f93d1e5cb.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/24af90035b72f127fe9715fc1f7219299690a0c0.png[/img]
More biomes to come as we continue to shape Darfall into what it’s meant to be: bold, unflinching, and beautifully bleak.

notes.title: DevBlog #23: Soren - Paladin of the Sunsteel Legion
notes.content:
Ah, gather ‘round, noble souls, for today, I speak of the last to join Darfall’s roster for release: [b]Soren, Paladin of the Sunsteel Legion[/b].

A radiant force clad in sacred steel and bound by divine purpose, he is no mere knight - he is a living testament to Solara’s will.

[h2]The Sunsteel Path: Power in Devotion[/h2]
The Paladins of the Sunsteel Legion are not born-they are forged. Through the sacred Rite of Illumination, they are transformed: taller, mightier, brimming with radiant strength. Their armor, hewn from blessed Sunsteel, is said to be impenetrable-save by the most accursed of blades.
But do not mistake Soren for a simple brute. He is a support hero,but in the right hands, he may very well be the strongest of them all.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/31066944b00d1ccebd4ac10108f88fe24ec568d5.jpg[/img]

[h2]Trait: Twin Auras of the Faithful[/h2]
[h3]Aura Noctis[/h3]
Active during the night, this aura banishes the darkness debuff for all nearby allies. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/0b3cb83267cb1f9171356a33521546ed9b26842e.png[/img]
While others hide behind their walls when night falls, you march boldly into the gloom, unhindered.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/cb58f122de9240928817bcc67142389e632e3c32.gif[/img]
[h3]Aura Solis[/h3]
At dawn’s light, Soren’s divine aura heals up to three allies near him over time. No chants, no rituals-just quiet, radiant restoration.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/8adb0330ba672bfd33bb8136b06ad7790699748f.png[/img]

[h2]Blessings: A Divine Resource[/h2]
The Paladin draws upon Blessings, a unique resource with a maximum of three at a time.
His abilities fall into two sacred categories:
[list][*][b]Blessing Generators[/b] - grant divine charges.
[*][b]Blessing Spenders[/b] – require energy and one Blessing.[/list]
Plan wisely, and you’ll find Soren unleashing power more frequently than any other hero.

[h2]Abilities of the Sunsteel Champion[/h2]
[h3]Light of Solara[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/b40e70044e50dc4fe760a718138b1aac2178f3ee.gif[/img]
A versatile spell: heals allies when grouped, or empowers Soren’s damage when he fights alone.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/14d68091b0bbeee2948ae33ab6091f68e1e7597f.png[/img]

[h3]Divine Conversion[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/065d0db2141332f747ad55d8590ddf0654b11a1b.gif[/img]
Perhaps the most curious magic of all - turn any Undead or Demon into your ally for a time. Even the vilest foes become your puppets beneath Solara’s light.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/10934e2902ed6f601b1cbcf45256f9284c42f4d8.png[/img]

[h3]Dawnblade’s Wrath[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/f86b082dbe0f6a72bf968de3475ba6891f3c4ae8.gif[/img]
A wide burst of radiant damage, ideal for repelling large waves. Simple, holy, effective.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/96439ddf740ff9ebdf327b1f1938b4e5d5d09064.png[/img]

[h3]Radiant Smite[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/f86b082dbe0f6a72bf968de3475ba6891f3c4ae8.gif[/img]
A single-target strike that generates a Blessing. Reliable and blessed with purpose.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/fc7cd3b0b9a43b5e7101d80901c870bbe9dae0ae.png[/img]

[h3]Solar Shield[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/827aad9b584fef23d84f21666a2824d1f5d1ca74.gif[/img]
Grants Soren a protective barrier. If broken, it explodes in divine fury. If it endures, it rewards you with a Blessing. Either way - victory.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/baeeb483bd61ba65b918fc917eb9267c3d09844d.png[/img]

[h3]Sunsteel Pact[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/fd45e44af6b60b60d3379f51615df50ac868afd5.gif[/img]
Forms a bond with an ally, naming them an acolyte of the Order. When they strike the enemy, there's a chance to generate Blessings for you. Enlightenment through teamwork.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/d1f287ffb961683f773bc816e4d504a8ef200f26.png[/img]

[h1]Soren: Life and Deeds[/h1]
Born in the frozen wilds of Skolgard, young Soren witnessed the horrors of the Darfall Wastes firsthand. He survived - but his village did not.

The Sunsteel Legion found him amidst the ruins, and though it was their own blades that slew both monster and villager alike, Soren was chosen. Trained. Transformed.

He emerged from the Rite of Illumination not with hatred-but with conviction. Even knowing the truth of his past, Soren remains loyal, believing in the Legion’s cold justice as the only true path to peace.

Any citizen, soldier or lord wanting to become a paladin, must train for years, practicing faith and teachings of Solara in the Sunsteel Monastery as an acolyte.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/0bb451688dbe92373558f3a17c43a006ff340615.png[/img]

In our library you can find more information about both [url=https://www.legendkeeper.com/app/clwc22o7s02t50xlfh4zhhow9/nynasy1n/]Soren[/url] and [url=https://www.legendkeeper.com/app/clwc22o7s02t50xlfh4zhhow9/clwxaa1mp000e3b6k5ist1wra/]Sunsteel Legion[/url].

notes.title: DevBlog #22: Garnet Ironfist – The Master Engineer
notes.content:
Ah, adventurers, let me tell you of a man whose hands shape the battlefield itself! Garnet Ironfist, the Engineer , is no mere warrior - he is a master of fortification, industry, and raw destructive force. With his master-forged hammers, he shatters enemies, reinforces defenses, and ensures your workers never slack off.

Let us explore the arsenal of this legendary builder of war!

[h2]Abilities: The Art of Destruction and Defense[/h2]
[h3]Shatterstrike: Break the Line[/h3]
With a mighty swing of his hammer, Garnet delivers a bone-crushing blow that slows enemy attack speed. Against powerful foes like orc warlords, this ability can be the deciding factor between victory and a swift, brutal defeat.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/c9bcdc741ca369928c76bea4ecb1b237d3fd1542.gif[/img]

[h3]Ale for Everyone: The Engineer’s Elixir[/h3]
Who needs magic when you have good, strong ale? Garnet tosses a mug to his workers, boosting their productivity and morale. Whether reinforcing your keep or expanding your economy, a well-timed drink can fuel an empire!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/c8a77ada369e215f93ebde15fa435885d9f817ea.gif[/img]

[h3]Defense War: The Bastion’s Shield[/h3]
Garnet is a master of fortification, and with Defense Ward, he grants an aura of resilience to nearby allies and structures, reducing incoming damage. Whether your walls are buckling or your frontline is wavering, this buff turns the tide of battle.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/b78a9692f8b5246d3fce40816cdea4cfb35c78f6.gif[/img]

[h3]Forge Cannon: The Artillery Masterpiece[/h3]
No hero in Darfall wields such firepower! Garnet summons a massive cannon that automatically fires at incoming enemies. Use it as a mobile war machine or a core piece in your fortress, and watch enemies crumble beneath its relentless bombardment.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/e49e25fa08c2573fca750379eea0ae499b6d9e93.gif[/img]

[h3]Engineer’s Wall: The Battlefield Architect[/h3]
Unlike other heroes, Garnet alone can construct new structures! Instantly deploy barriers to block enemy paths, reinforce weak points, or shield your Forge Cannon, turning the battlefield into a fortress under your command.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/9ae680474cd42c79915f1a8614697a039afbf39d.gif[/img]

[h2]Special Trait: Prospector’s Advantage[/h2]
Garnet’s knowledge of industry grants him the unique ability to mine Iron veins from the very start. This early boost accelerates armor production, fortifications, and elite unit training, setting up a stronghold before enemies can even mount an offense.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/87a2536c16dcdf4aa54a618bfcfe3ad4145fd43e.gif[/img]

[h2]The Legacy of Garnet Ironfist[/h2]
Once a proud defender of Ironpeak Hold, Garnet’s family stood against the relentless orc invasions until their home fell to ruin. Having survived the Great Conflagration that turned the Verdan Expanse into a wasteland, he vowed never to let another fortress fall.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/87f24049b7668222e7ccb15f199c6b2caf018bd3.png[/img]
Over time, he founded the Ironfist Guild of Engineers, renowned for building unbreakable defenses. Their crowning achievement? Watermeuse Fort - a bastion on the edge of the Deadlands, standing firm against orcish hordes.

With steel, sweat, and ingenuity, Garnet ensures that what he builds will stand the test of time.

If you want to learn more about him - welcome to our [url=https://www.legendkeeper.com/app/clwc22o7s02t50xlfh4zhhow9/clyxg2t1t000i3b6ojnzlcj1d/]library[/url]!

notes.title: DevBlog #21: The Art of Survival
notes.content:
Ah, adventurers! The realm of Darfall is ever-changing, and today we bring wondrous news of [b]expanded inventory, biome survival mechanics, and tactical improvements[/b] to sharpen your strategies. Let us delve into these enhancements!

[h2]Backpacks: Carry More, Raid Longer![/h2]

A wise adventurer knows that space is as valuable as steel. With backpacks, you can gather more loot, stockpile more supplies, and stay on the battlefield longer - no more retreating mid-raid because your pouches are overflowing!

[b]Loot Drops[/b] – found in treasure chests and enemy caches.
[b]Crafting [/b]– establish a Tailor and hunt wildlife for materials to craft superior bags.

A proper adventurer never leaves treasure behind!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/269e3a1b5817fa1532bf50cf6fab2930e10e847a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/ec9d4c831087dd10b280dd1258e625fda4c63a2f.png[/img]

[h2]Fishing: A Lifeline in Harsh Lands[/h2]

When crops fail and food runs scarce, turn to the waters! [b]Fishing Huts [/b]provide a steady source of sustenance, ensuring your settlement remains well-fed even in the most barren landscapes.

Simply place a [b]Fishing Hut[/b] near a body of water, assign workers, and let nature provide.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/f891c1854150641c4ceae6c15f9ff45861d5a900.png[/img]

[h2]Biome Survival: Adapt or Perish[/h2]
Each biome in Darfall presents unique dangers and challenges. Wise rulers will learn to adapt their strategies to survive.
[h3]Grasslands: A Land of Fire and Storms[/h3]
[list][*] Lightning storms can ignite deadly wildfires.
[*] Fire spreads dynamically, burning forests and buildings alike.
[*] Establish firebreaks and prepare for sudden blazes![/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/48dd0b8b62f4d0f5e5f2e854d114db6711ec6c99.png[/img]
[h3]Desert: The Wrath of the Sun[/h3]
[list][*] Heatwaves slow workers and drain stamina.
[*] Beer upgrade improves work efficiency - hydration, after all, is key to survival!
[/list][h3]Swamps: A Maze of Mud[/h3]
[list][*] Mud slows all units - use it to hinder enemies and fortify your defenses.
[*] Roads improve movement, keeping workers efficient and armies mobile.[/list]

[h2]Tactical Enhancements: Smarter Combat, Better Formations[/h2]
Gone are the days of chaotic melees and units stacking on top of each other! Battles in Darfall now feel more strategic, more fluid, and more visually engaging.
[h3]Collider System – No More Clustering[/h3]
[list][*] Melee units now hold proper spacing in combat.
[*] Larger enemies (e.g., Rotting Colossus) feel more impactful with bigger collision sizes.[/list]
[h3]Unit Formations – Smarter Positioning[/h3]
[list][*] Ranged units stay behind melee fighters, ensuring proper battle lines.
[*] Better unit separation prevents overcrowding in fights.
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/f0613786f6db019ff40776fa9454c04d20e17c43.png[/img]

[h2]Building Upgrades: Simple, Fast, Efficient[/h2]

No more hunting through endless menus for building upgrades!
[b]Old System[/b]: Tedious UI navigation, scattered upgrades, and unnecessary complexity.
[b]New System[/b]: Select a building → Instantly see all available upgrades → Upgrade with a single click!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/dd5a2579a21e1cb5a502293f087261b5124acd17.png[/img]

[h2]The Final Wave: A Grand Finale Worthy of Legends[/h2]

The Final Wave, the last stand of your settlement, has been reforged into an unforgettable battle:

Countdown Timer – a one-day warning before the final attack.
Epic Ambiance – music, meteor showers, and intense screen effects.
Wave Tracking – the enemy’s location is now visible on the minimap, letting you reposition defenses before the storm hits.
A Proper Victory Celebration – after the last demon falls, you’ll have a moment to bask in glory before the victory screen.

[h2]More to Come: Refining the World of Darfall[/h2]

Our artisans are tirelessly refining Darfall’s world, adding more environmental details, richer enemy camps, and a greater sense of history in every battlefield.

From orc fortresses with stronger defenses (and more heads on spikes!) to the Spider Queen’s lair teeming with eggs and webs, each enemy stronghold will feel more alive - and more dangerous.

The realm is shifting, evolving, preparing for your return. [b]Will you be ready?[/b]

notes.title: DevBlog #20: Procedural Maps and Legendary Loot
notes.content:
Ah, adventurers! The world of [b]Darfall [/b]is ever-changing, its landscapes shaped by magic, chaos, and the relentless march of time. Today, let us peer behind the veil and uncover the wonders of procedural map generation and the legendary artifacts that lie hidden within these perilous lands!

[h2]The Art of Procedural Map Generation[/h2]

No two adventures in Darfall are the same, for the land itself shifts and reshapes with every journey. Using [b]Perlin noise[/b], we craft living, breathing worlds - forests whisper with unseen dangers, rivers carve through valleys, and mountains stand as silent sentinels of forgotten ages.

Let us take a closer look at how the [b]Desert biome[/b] comes to life:

[b]Step 1: A Blank Canvas[/b]
Every great adventure begins with an untouched land, painted with the foundation of its biome.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/1f438dbc2b4d79ac3833d1d312e782b2c4a01468.jpg[/img]

[b]Step 2: Sculpting the Terrain[/b]
Mountains rise, valleys deepen - but in this arid wasteland, lakes are but a forgotten dream.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/4b46c34b032b8de97b37885f31ae9b569c0606a7.jpg[/img]

[b]Step 3: Seeding Resources[/b]
Even in the harshest of deserts, life finds a way. Trees, stone, and iron veins emerge, waiting to be claimed.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/85c94f64b0c91325166bdbee911d35f3636002ac.jpg[/img]

[b]Step 4: Oasis – A Beacon of Hope[/b]
Ah, the desert’s most precious secret! These rare patches of green provide sanctuary, rich with fertile land and life-giving wood. Guard them well!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/0c70464a95b27cbc496964a5317848fb250accfd.jpg[/img]

[b]Step 5: The Perils of the Wilds[/b]
But what is an untamed land without danger?
[b]Orcs, undead, scorpids, and dust banes[/b]
lurk within, their camps teeming with loot, hazards, and foes eager to cut your journey short.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/1314b1f80bd0d44835b41cace4563209f735071d.jpg[/img]

[b]Step 6: The Final Challenge – Enemy Strongholds[/b]
Ruined villages, towering fortresses, and cursed battlegrounds rise across the land, filled with enemies, treasures, and hidden dangers. No two will ever be the same, making every raid an unpredictable test of skill!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/f894a4e5ecc5e44309cbdeff90406f211e42aadb.jpg[/img]

[h2]Legendary Treasures of Darfall[/h2]

Among the ruins and within the darkest corners of Darfall lie legendary artifacts, relics of immense power whispered about in taverns and war camps alike.

Marked by a [b]distinct glow[/b], these artifacts are as rare as they are powerful  - echoing the legendary loot of Diablo. But be warned: they are only found in the hands of elite foes such as the [b]Orc Warchief[/b] or the [b]Undead Warlord[/b].

Behold, some of the treasures that await the bold:
- [b]Dreaded Darkplate[/b] – a caster’s salvation! This enchanted robe conjures a [b]protective barrier[/b], shielding its wearer from harm.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/90cbe9c0e86fafa81c99a98cfdeb80a796b2650b.jpg[/img])    
- [b]Phantom Mask[/b] – strike fear into the hearts of your enemies! This eerie mask [b]immobilizes foes[/b], rendering them helpless before your might.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/f1442da772b196aff51085cbb727f196902e50e1.jpg[/img]

Such relics do not come easily, but for those who dare, they may mean the difference between triumph and ruin.

[h2]What’s Next for Map Generation?[/h2]
Our artisans continue to refine the lands of Darfall, ensuring each map feels like a world ravaged by demonic invasion. David is hard at work adding more environmental details, from shattered ruins to remnants of civilizations long lost.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/f0e194d402f006c0bcdbd67eab9492a5bfeb2e32.jpg[/img]

But that’s not all! Enemy camps are being reworked to feel more alive ([i]or… unalive, in the case of undead zones[/i]). Expect stronger fortifications, richer detail, and, for orc camps, more heads on spikes - a proper welcome for those who dare intrude.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/14e24a3dca4764dd56389e39cd98c98b5887205a.jpg[/img]

And this is only the beginning! The Spider Queen’s Lair, for example, will soon teem with cocoons, webs, and egg clusters - a true nightmare for the unprepared.

So, adventurers, sharpen your blades and ready your spells, for the world of Darfall is alive and ever-changing. 

The land is waiting. Step forth and claim your legend!

notes.title: Scenario Creation Contest
notes.content:
Adventurers, the time has come to unleash your creativity! Darfall Scenario Creation Contest is here, and we’re calling on you to craft the most engaging, original scenario using the Darfall Scenario Editor.

[h3]Rewards for the Bold[/h3]
Winners will be awarded darfall keys and a special Discord role. And, of course, special recognition for winners from the devs!

[h3]Learn More[/h3]
Need help? We just posted a [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1961600/announcements/detail/515199938040168711]dev diary and video tutorial[/url]!

And if you prefer another format - check [url=https://squarenite.notion.site/Darfall-Scenario-Editor-13075e13a8a580b5b92dd4bda91032f1]documentation on Notion[/url] for tips.

[h2]Rules[/h2]
[expand type=details expanded=false] 
[h2]Objective:[/h2]
Create an engaging, original scenario for Darfall. Entries must include finished maps (even if small), as unfinished submissions will not be counted.

[h2]Submission Guidelines:[/h2]
1. Participation:
    - Open to all community members.
    - Submissions shouldn’t be copies of other participant’s works.
2. Content Requirements:
    - Each entry must include:
        - A clear description of the scenario.
        - A finished map (even if small), created using the Darfall scenario editor.
    - Incomplete or placeholder submissions will not be accepted.
3. Submission Process:
    - Submissions must be uploaded to [url=http://mod.io]mod.io[/url] and linked in the contest channel on [url=https://discord.com/invite/Pz9kpaQ88b]Discord[/url].
    - Deadline: All entries must be submitted by 14/02/2025.
    - If you want to submit a different scenario later - you can do this! Just add “Replacement submission” in the message with the new scenario and we will count only the last entry.
4. Limits:
    - Maximum of one entry per participant.
    - Collaborative submissions are allowed but will count as a single entry.

[h2]Judging Criteria:[/h2]
[list][*] Submissions will be judged based on:
[*] Creativity and originality of the scenario concept.
[*] Quality and functionality of the map.
[*] Alignment with the Darfall theme and mechanics.
[*] Playability and balance.[/list]

The judging panel will consist of our Developers, and winners will be announced one week after the end of the contest.

[h2]Prizes:[/h2]
The number of winners will depend on the total number of entries:

- At least 10 entries: 1 Winner (Receives 2 Darfall keys).
- At least 15 entries: 2 Winners
    - 1st place: 2 Darfall keys.
    - 2nd place: 1 Darfall key.
- At least 20 entries: 3 Winners
    - 1st place: 2 Darfall keys.
    - 2nd place: 1 Darfall key.
    - 3rd place: 1 Darfall key.

Each winner will additionally receive a shout-out and a special role - @Guild Cartographer

If fewer than 10 submissions are received, the contest may be extended or we will choose a winner among the participants.

[h2]Additional Rules:[/h2]
[olist][*] The scenario must be your own work (though you can copy classic maps or be inspired by other creations). 
[*] By entering, you grant permission for your submission to be featured or showcased in Darfall-related content.
[*] All entries must adhere to community guidelines. Offensive or inappropriate content will be disqualified.[/olist]
[/expand]

We look forward to seeing your creative scenarios and maps!

notes.title: DevBlog #19: Darfall Scenario Editor
notes.content:
Welcome, adventurers! The power to create your own scenario (or even campaign!) lies at your fingertips with the [b]Darfall Scenario Editor[/b]. We have prepeared this video guide to walk you through crafting your very first scenario: an ambush where your Ardan faces off against enemy orcs. 

There is also a text version below!

[previewyoutube=Rz28V57XQ44;full][/previewyoutube]
And if it won't be enough - there is [url=https://squarenite.notion.site/Darfall-Scenario-Editor-13075e13a8a580b5b92dd4bda91032f1]documentation on Notion[/url]. 

And here is a text version of the video:
[expand type=details expanded=false] 
[h2]Step 1: Set the Stage[/h2]
1. Terrain Painting
    - Choose terrain tools and assets that fit your scenario. For an ambush setting, use demonic dirt, orc land, and ominous lava lakes.
    - Adjust details by painting mountains, burnt trees, and grasses to add depth.
    - Use the [b]Shift [/b]key to erase and refine your terrain.
2. Add Features
    - Place rock formations, resize and rotate them for a rugged look. This step helps create a visually compelling and immersive battlefield.

[h2]Step 2: Place Heroes and Enemies[/h2]
Add Characters
    - Place [b]Ardan [/b]and his adversaries - the [b]Orc Sharpshooters[/b] and their leader, [b]Ragnok[/b].
2. Assign Teams and Tags
    - Ardan → Player team, Alpha tag.
    - Orcs + Ragnok → Team 1, Beta tag.
3. Adjust Stats
    - Fine-tune HP, damage, and other attributes for balance.

[h2]Step 3: Create the Cutscene[/h2]
1. Set Up a Trigger Region
    - Define a region where the ambush begins as Ardan enters.
2. Build the Cutscene
    - Add a trigger event: “When Ardan enters the region.”
    - Create actions such as camera pans, dialogue sequences, and movement freezes to stage the ambush. Use the “Show Dialogue” action to add character conversations.
3. End the Scene
    - Resume game time to transition seamlessly into battle.

[h2]Step 4: Design Quests[/h2]
1. Main Quest: Defeat the Orcs.
    - Sub-quest 1: Defeat Enemy Orcs ([b]Progressive Task[/b]).
        - Create a [b]variable counter[/b], Enemy Orcs, starting at 0.
    - Sub-quest 2: Defeat Ragnok ([b]Single Task[/b]).
        - Triggered by his defeat at any point in the scenario.
2. Quest Flow
    - Ensure tasks can be completed in any order for player flexibility.

[h2]Step 5: Link Triggers for Gameplay[/h2]
1. Activate Quests
    - Create a trigger to activate quests post-cutscene and reactivate Ardan’s movement.
2. Track Progress
    - Add events for orc deaths: “[b]When Sharpshooter dies[/b]”, increase the Enemy Orcs counter.
3. Complete Tasks
    - Set conditions:
        - “[b]When counter reaches 2/2[/b]”, mark Defeat Enemy Orcs as complete.
        - “[b]When Ragnok dies[/b]”, mark Defeat Ragnok as complete.

[h2]Step 6: Mission Accomplished[/h2]
1. Final Trigger
    - Create a condition: All Beta enemies (orcs + Ragnok) are defeated.
2. Victory Actions
    - Complete the main quest, fade the screen, and trigger a game win state to celebrate the player’s success![/expand]

[h2]Your Turn to Create![/h2]

This is just the beginning of what you can craft with the Darfall Scenario Editor. 

Now, adventurer, it’s your time to shine. Set the stage and share your masterpiece with the world! 🌟

notes.title: 0.11 Update: RPG Hero Selection, Hero Traits & Localization
notes.content:
[b]Greetings, Darfall Players![/b]

We’re thrilled to announce that the latest content update, [b]0.11[/b], is now live!

This update focuses on polishing the experience with numerous fixes and tweaks, but the spotlight is on the addition of Chinese and German localization, a brand-new RPG-styled hero selection screen, and the introduction of class Traits.

[h2]Hero Selection[/h2]

To enhance the immersive fantasy experience of Heroes, we’ve reworked the character selection screen! You can now view your heroes in fully 3D, bringing the RPG vibes to life, similar to what you’d find in MMORPGs. Since Darfall blends city-building and RPG gameplay, we could never miss this feature!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/9438c11c77661461f8034cd961240e724d013916.gif[/img]
(Huge props to our talented artist Jakub for making such an fantastic scene)

The screen will be improved with few more details and animations as we will near the full release this year.

[h2]Class Traits[/h2]

Each hero now comes with a unique trait tailored to their class. In the Demo, this is available for the Mage, Ardan.

You can now experience his Energy Overflow trait: locate an Energy Fountain on the map, stand inside it, and charge up the buff to its full duration.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/70e543eed1877625b5612dd3d7acc1a958f32285.jpg[/img]

With the Energy Overflow buff, Ardan’s energy capacity doubles, enabling him to unleash a devastating barrage of magic on invaders, or the occasional unlucky orcs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/deb53dca05a0dab5e3ff7f067a1c2372c5ecd1e1.jpg[/img]

[h2]0.11 Changelist[/h2]

[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Survival: Brand new RPG style hero selection screen
[/list]

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Increased the size of the "Under Attack" marker for better visibility
[*] Added German and Chinese localizations
[*] Reworked the model of the Cryptstalker
[*] Scenario Editor: Updated scenario editor icons

[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]

[/list]

If you encounter any issues or want to share a suggestion, feel free to do so in our discord [url=https://discord.com/channels/826887508326613042/1066300594203152405]suggestions[/url] forum, or [url=https://discord.com/channels/826887508326613042/1066300698834251816]bug-reports[/url] forum respectively.

As always, we deeply value your feedback and suggestions as we continue to refine Darfall. Thank you for your incredible support, and we can’t wait to hear what you think about this update!

Stay tuned for more exciting updates and improvements,
[b]SquareNite[/b] - from beyond the darkness of the Darfall Wastes.

notes.title: DevBlog #18: Meet Nariel, the Beastmaster
notes.content:
Ah, adventurers, let me regale you with the tale of Nariel - ranger, summoner, and a force of nature. Trained by the elves and tempered by loss, she roams the Moorlands with her bow in hand and beasts at her side, waging a silent war against the vampiric Revenants.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/1138212bfa6de052f909ec937c9ba86e468c2d29.gif[/img]

[h1]Abilities to Command the Wilds[/h1]

[h2][b]Spider Swarm[/b]: [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/be3d4af6fb3d76eab5fc04e9896c5ddae09fdf01.jpg[/img]
Unleash a venomous wave of spiders that melt through even the toughest armor. A truly satisfying way to deal with foes!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/ccccecc4154e22e1072c867091513104aa8a203a.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Rain of Arrows[/b]: [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/7e0a291b2459399886d095cbd017e513140a63a9.jpg[/img]
Call down a deadly rain of arrows, perfectly timed to devastate large groups of enemies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/a69dcdf6ffac6cd28735e98ecbdc9d509fc4f34a.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Piercing Shot[/b]: [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/9552b156b90c26aeb7104d8b7059d560c429ab62.jpg[/img]
A precise, high-damage attack that causes bleeding - perfect for armored enemies and tight clusters alike.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/d260257a3ecc2c55e969052a7b4a2e065aa17b83.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Feral Ally[/b]: [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/4ae4ec7ab47a4c004d3c09ac4a7920192cae7bf2.jpg[/img]
Nariel’s signature ability allows her to summon powerful animal companions to fight by her side. Each rank upgrades not only the stats of Nariel’s current companion but also introduces a new, stronger ally. The ability to have a combat-ready companion from the first day sets Nariel apart, making her a strategic powerhouse.

[i]Direwolf[/i] (Rank 1): Summoned from the very start, this loyal ally is perfect for early survival mode, bolstering your ability to clear enemies near your base.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/a2b53504ce2a486c2d06ad352a42c2c0e78706c3.gif[/img]
[i]Bear [/i](Rank 2): With significant health, the bear excels as a tank, soaking up damage and protecting Nariel and her forces.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/b6ba95c5692f873cc31fd6e5627efa2af5f65b8d.gif[/img]
[i]Lion [/i](Rank 3): The pinnacle of her summons, the lion combines immense health and devastating damage, making it a force to rival even late-game units.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/819c3c2e4cd354c2aba8a540bd0f6357fd1dd593.gif[/img]

[h2][b]Primal Fury[/b]:[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/b800dd4d4d1a43e00521b899f264750bb82c0875.jpg[/img]: 
Sends summoned beasts into a frenzy, vastly increasing their attack speed.

[h2][b]Feral Trap:[/b][/h2] 

Nariel’s traps are a versatile tool for controlling the battlefield.
[i]Immobilization[/i]: Set traps to stop dangerous enemies, such as wild beasts or invaders, in their tracks. Once trapped, enemies cannot move or attack, giving Nariel the edge.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/174be81029cf97379d56351c0ac1fa2525a02a6b.gif[/img]
[i]Ambush Preparation[/i]: Lay multiple traps around key areas to create deadly surprises for incoming enemies. Perfect for fortifying your defenses or protecting choke points.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/6012613c005b5f229de0ff47ecc96952d817e7a1.png[/img]
Whether used tactically during combat or preemptively for defense, Feral Trap ensures Nariel always has the upper hand.

[h1]Special Trait[/h1]

Nariel’s bond with nature allows her to unlock white and green Nature treasure chests without keys. A boon for any adventurer seeking powerful gear!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/14f92c8bb0b59fe98ef9f778a216c4392673513e.png[/img]

[h1]A Tale of Loss and Resolve[/h1]

Once a leader of the Moorland rangers, Nariel’s life changed forever after a failed mission to capture the vampire Count Valthazar. The mission left her sister Morrigan turned into a vampiric husk, setting Nariel on a path of vengeance and redemption.

Now, she fights tirelessly to protect her homeland and its people, wielding her unmatched skill and her connection to the wild. And perhaps, one day, we’ll uncover what became of Morrigan...

And if you want to learn more about Nariel - [url=https://www.legendkeeper.com/app/clwc22o7s02t50xlfh4zhhow9/clwc8xys205aw3b6jdaw20w8v/]doors of our library[/url] are always opened for those with an inquisitive mind!

notes.title: DevBlog #17: Survival Mode Deep Dive
notes.content:
Ah, where to begin, dear adventurers? Aganor is no mere chart of locations - it’s a masterpiece of lore, geography, and challenges waiting to be conquered. From bustling towns to the desolate Deadlands, this map teems with life, peril, and the whispers of ancient tales. And [b]Survival Mode[/b] will guide you through it...

Begin your journey in [b]Edgescar[/b], the gateway to the legendary [b]Throneveld[/b]. Each victory unlocks new biomes, ramping up the challenges and days required for survival. Traverse first biomes to overcome the Deadlands, where [b]Watermeuse Fort[/b] and [b]Eskerton Hold[/b] offer the hardest trials in all of Darfall.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/2f581621b9180b62fffd0b3b60f60f4d4af982a5.jpg[/img]

[h3]Deadlands[/h3]
Deadlands have a rich lore in Darfall, once being a lush forest with diverse races and dragons, now stands as a toxic, lava wasteland with nothing but ruins of old kingdoms.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/c078b37749f5aa64fd1cbd1f5627a5e28e09b970.png[/img]
These last 2 maps, Watermeuse Fort and Eskerton Hold offer the hardest challenge in the game.

More on the deadlands I will tell you later...

[h2]Biomes: Trials of the Realms[/h2]
Each corner of Aganor offers a unique challenge, crafted to test your mettle and reward your cunning:

[h3]Grasslands[/h3] 
The perfect beginning for a brave adventurer. The Grasslands are abundant in food and wood, but beware - storms roll in without warning, bringing fire and chaos.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/0da8e977cc566687ef73e185867303ecf500fc42.png[/img]
[b]Biome Feature - Storms[/b]
Storms spark wildfires but can be harnessed to create fiery defenses.

Lore: [i]The towns we are to re-build here belonged to a Windmar kingdom, the richest of the human kingdoms, that being until it fell to the overwhelming forces of the demons. No amounts of gold can buy you out of of that one.[/i]

[h3]Desert[/h3]
Harsh and barren, the Desert offers little food but rich veins of iron. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/da7d20e96814532d2ddbd00289233c414bbb4c3d.png[/img]
Oases are rare gems, providing fertile ground for farming and much-needed wood.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/997cc1e9648c89eb1e9a2a4022cd4d4a03e1bd5e.png[/img]
[b]Biome Feature - Heatwaves[/b]
Heatwaves drain your workers unless you keep them refreshed with… beer! 

Lore: [i]These parts of the continent are not united under 1 kingdom, but rather under different families, the most prominent one being Allerton[/i].

[h3]Swamp[/h3]
Foggy and treacherous, the Swamp slows expansion with its muddy terrain and roaming wraiths. Yet wood is plentiful for those who persevere.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/fbece1ae998e29d5e0de1d7adb78aa32b0ee5aac.png[/img]
[b]Biome Feature - Mud[/b]
Mud bogs your forces - build roads to keep your army mobile.

[h3]Frozen Highlands[/h3]
A true test of endurance. Low crop yields and roaming Yetis make survival daunting, especially when blizzards strike.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/4891bf160262854677734f1222c6f1ebd143d86d.png[/img]
[b]Biome Feature - Blizzard[/b]
Blizzards slow movement and freeze workers; braziers are essential for warmth.

[h3]Deadlands[/h3]
The ultimate challenge. Toxic and barren, the Deadlands are home to the feral Dragnir - once mighty dragons, now haunting ruins.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/793ea00bb66c10d54d68ef277a34f482e847ec70.png[/img]
[b]Biome Feature[/b]
Everything here wants to kill you. Prepare for battle, or perish.

Lore: [i]Once a lush region of the continent known as Verdan Expanse, it was home to variety of races, mainly dragons. As orcs and humans began expanding into their territory, the last desperate action, led by mighty dragon Ashscorn was to burn the entire region into cinders, the land trembled, the vulcanos erupted. It not only wiped out humans and orcs, but also dragons themseves, turning them into now feral Dragnir roaming Deadlands[/i].

[h2]The Continent Map - Aganor[/h2]
Aganor is brought to life with drifting clouds, dynamic geography, and a tapestry of history. This map isn’t just for survival; it’s the stage for your grand journey, culminating in a large-scale demonic invasion threatening all life in the realm.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/3c3d67da45781b5373b0f839767facdc0db27751.jpg[/img]

Learn more about the rich history of this world in our [url=https://www.legendkeeper.com/app/clwc22o7s02t50xlfh4zhhow9/clwc22osd00053b6kgn47x604/]library[/url].

Prepare to write your story, adventurer. Aganor awaits your courage, strategy, and destiny. The realm is yours to shape!
