notes.title: DevBlog #16 - Of Axes, Orcs, and Carnage: Meet Kalen, the Slayer
notes.content:
Ah, greetings, brave adventurers!

Today, I bring tidings of blood, steel, and a hero forged in the crucible of chaos. Allow me to introduce you to Darfall’s second class - the indomitable Slayer. You shall take up arms as Kalen, a warrior of unparalleled ferocity hailing from the fabled [b]Watermeuse Fort[/b].

But don’t be fooled by his rugged demeanor; Kalen is as much a strategist as he is a force of nature. Let me regale you with tales of his abilities, his storied past, and the unique gifts that make him the bane of orcs and monsters alike. Prepare yourselves for pure, unadulterated carnage!

[h2]Abilities Wrought from Battle[/h2]
Kalen’s arsenal is a symphony of destruction, each ability designed to leave foes trembling in awe - or simply cleaved in two. Let us explore these feats of might:

[h3]Rending Throw[/h3]
Lo, before the clash even begins, Kalen takes the first strike! Hurling his mighty axe to a distant point, he rends his enemies, causing them to [i]bleed[/i], while those near the impact are left [i]stunned[/i], wondering what hit them.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/606286f0f586d2c7c5b77a418048ccf002b3c4d6.gif[/img]
[i]A word of advice: always keep an eye on flying axes.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/6c5c0fb0b60aff54c18c9c9baca6f4ffbc8eaa9c.png[/img]

[h3]Charge[/h3]
When subtlety fails (and with Kalen, it often does), why not charge headlong into the fray? With an impact that [i]stuns [/i]the first foe in his path, Kalen ensures that even the most stalwart of enemies feel the weight of his fury.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/4936981dc254fc85e99620cfa9e2bf971bf87154.gif[/img]
[i]Not for the faint of heart - but perfect for breaking the lines![/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/d1765a98f5b8b0a4eb612e12d2d5d6333229d1d3.png[/img]

[h3]Cleave[/h3]
Should your enemies dare to close in, Kalen’s axe is ready to meet them. With a [i]sweeping strike[/i] as powerful as it is precise, he turns clusters of orcs into lamb chops.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/d24720b1653a45225fff105f12645db6191daf79.gif[/img]
[i]Messy, you say? Gloriously so.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/5ef54a216367ddba351c30cfcc91188a1d3bb544.png[/img]

[h3]Break Armor[/h3]
Ah, the bane of knights and monstrous beasts alike! Kalen’s expertise lies in [i]shattering defenses[/i]. With a single devastating strike, he removes his target’s armor entirely, rendering them [i]vulnerable [/i]to your forces’ wrath.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/2dd1ea01d60b3d995e9f96aeb623b52c73a9197b.gif[/img]
[i]Even the toughest foes cannot withstand the might of the Slayer.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/328cde31d09ede1fd583d23e5742503b124bf27e.png[/img]

[h3]Power Strike[/h3]
For those moments when a single target must fall - be it an Elite or a towering Boss - Kalen unleashes the Power Strike. Chain it with [i]Break Armor[/i], and even the most formidable enemies will melt before your eyes.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/979651262a989fff96ffe583094be6a95034c77e.gif[/img]
[i]Truly, the stuff of legends.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/7f958537fcfebdce22be0a8cdad4dfd1bf2c1b7b.png[/img]

[h3]Bloodthirst[/h3]
Should the battle press on and Kalen find himself surrounded, fear not! With each hit he lands, Kalen [i]heals himself[/i], ensuring he can fight on until the battlefield is his alone.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/f640c1c7d0546386b6e0f260eec6535e60c0ad37.gif[/img]
[i]An unrelenting force, unstoppable and unbroken.[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/6ea758161106ccefa61b5d7e9c1de016355e13d8.png[/img]

[h3]Special Trait: Battle Standard[/h3]
As if his abilities weren’t enough, Kalen inspires those around him with his [i]Battle Standard[/i], [i]increasing the attack speed[/i] of all nearby melee units by 10%.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/f75a79b5b63a3cf9e0fa08119db3683b0d5d7d9d.png[/img]
[i]Lead the charge, and watch your allies rise to greatness.[/i]

[h3]The Lore of Kalen: A Slayer Forged in Fire[/h3]
Where hardship reigns, heroes rise.” So goes the creed of the [b]Baneforged[/b], the elite warriors of [b]Watermeuse For[/b]t. Kalen’s story begins in the shadow of orcish raids, forcing his family into a life of constant peril. It was at [b]Watermeuse Fort[/b] where his fate changed, avoiding imprisonment by embracing the grueling trials of the Baneforged.

Earning his place among their ranks, Kalen slew a drake in the [b]Deadlands[/b], marking him as a true warrior. Ever since, his axe has carved a path of glory and vengeance, defending the realms from monstrous threats and orcish hordes.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/890b90e11a6a09d7ec6c15d6eafa8b3061c9ffbb.png[/img]
[b]The Baneforged:[/b]
Forged in hardship and honed in peril, the Baneforged are warriors of legend. Summoned to face the most dire of threats, they are as infamous for their bravery as they are for their origin - many are criminals, choosing this path over death or imprisonment.

For the full tale of Kalen, go to [url=https://www.legendkeeper.com/app/clwc22o7s02t50xlfh4zhhow9/clwc24451004s3b6kazbusgzo] the library[/url].

notes.title: DevBlog #15 - Of Perks, Heroes, and Inspiring Tales
notes.content:
Ah, gather close, brave adventurers! Today, I bring you tales of opportunity and inspiration - of how your heroes shall grow into legends through the wonders of perks, and how their mere presence can light a fire in the hearts of their loyal subjects. Let us venture forth into these chronicles of customization and leadership!


[h1]Meet the Champions: Heroes of Legend[/h1]
Lo and behold, the heroes of Darfall, each ready to lend their might and wisdom to your cause. But consider this merely a glimpse into the tales of these champions - rest assured, more of their legends shall be revealed in due time!

[h2]Kalen, the Slayer[/h2]

Kalen is a force of nature, excelling in close combat with abilities that turn the tide of any skirmish. His [i]Cleave [/i]ability strikes multiple foes in a wide arc, making it perfect for dealing with clustered enemies. Meanwhile, [i]Bloodthirst [/i]heals Kalen for a portion of the damage he deals, allowing him to stay in the thick of the fight longer than most.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/3cf3de75091e95156e9d9aa62a062a8ef625616c.png[/img]

[h2]Ardan, the Mage[/h2]

Ardan wields elemental magic to devastating effect, excelling at controlling the battlefield and eliminating groups of enemies. His [i]Inferno [/i]spell unleashes waves of fire, burning through hordes of foes with ease. On the other hand, [i]Freezing Nova[/i] creates a blast of cold that slows and damages enemies, providing an excellent tool for crowd control.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/6611de01cba0f2dc11b537521a7c903b15e76a90.png[/img]

[h2]Nariel, the Beastmaster:[/h2]

Nariel combines long-range precision with the support of nature’s fiercest companions. Her traps and poison abilities create zones of danger that weaken or eliminate enemies over time, while her animal allies, such as [i]Direwolves[/i] and [i]Bears[/i], can engage enemies directly, providing both offense and distraction.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/6f6c57118d42f04dad36ab4f2c90860f3b017c6a.png[/img]
    

[h2]The Perk System: A Tapestry of Power[/h2]

Customization, dear friends, is the lifeblood of Darfall. Our perk system is no ordinary list of enhancements - it is a tapestry where your choices forge the destiny of your heroes:

[b]Bolster Strength or Resolve[/b]: Whether by increasing health or sharpening their blades for greater damage, your heroes can rise to new heights of prowess.

[b]Harness Ingenious Abilities[/b]: Imagine mining resources with ease or doubling your loot - immense reaches are within your grasp!

[b]Tailor Your Strategy[/b]: Carefully assign points to create heroes who match your playstyle, whether offensive or defensive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/989db39b09467481401ff6cc399a2f5a644b3b7a.jpg[/img]

[h3]How to Earn Perk Points[/h3]

Ah, the paths to power are many and varied:

[list]
[*] [b]Through Valor and Triumph[/b]: Each level your hero attains grants a precious perk point.
[*] [b]Through Ancient Tomes[/b]: Seek the fabled [i]Books of Knowledge[/i], rare treasures dropped by elite foes or carefully crafted at the Library with mana orbs.
[/list]

Like the branches of a mystical tree, this system encourages exploration and rewards curiosity. And mark my words - this is just the beginning. The tree will grow, adding new boughs of progression and mechanics for the bold to conquer.

[h1]Unique Perks: The Spice of Heroism[/h1]

Each hero class bears a unique gift, a perk that sets them apart and adds a dash of intrigue to their role in your grand saga:

[b]Nariel, the Beastmaster[/b]: Can unlock common treasure chests scattered across the wilderness without needing a key. Why bother with keys when nature herself provides?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/2e11910647222f930edd9dc87f709a6b67636df0.jpg[/img]

[b]Kalen, the Slayer[/b]: Starts with the [i]Iron Mining[/i] perk, allowing you to gather iron from the very start, even before outposts are built. Truly a blacksmith’s dream come true!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/2d9b5573bf5d17b92abc3093e3bdd2b4814f2a8a.jpg[/img]

[b]Ardan, the Mage[/b]: Ah, a mystery still brewing in the arcane cauldron - stay tuned, for his unique gift shall soon be revealed!

These perks are more than abilities; they are invitations to experiment and discover new ways to shape your adventure.


[h1]Inspiring Workers: The Aura of Leadership[/h1]

A hero’s duty does not end on the battlefield. When they walk among the workers of your realm, their presence alone inspires greatness. Imagine this: your hero stands near, and suddenly the workers redouble their efforts, spurred on by the glow of their leadership.

Should you see a green arrow hovering above your workers, know that it is your hero’s aura urging them onward. Use this power wisely - whether bolstering your economy during times of peace or preparing for the coming storm of undead invaders.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/3156b292eced63b15afe3672d525225ce91bd6e5.png[/img]

And so, dear adventurer, until we meet again, may your perks shine brightly, your heroes inspire endlessly, and your kingdom thrive under your watchful command!

notes.title: 0.10 Content Update Available Now! (Demo)
notes.content:
[b]Greetings, Darfall Players![/b]

We’re excited to announce that the latest content update, [b]0.10[/b], is now live! 

This update brings a host of improvements and new features as we continue working towards the full release. Let’s dive into the highlights of what’s new in this demo update.


[h2]Window Bar Rework[/h2]

The bottom bar has been redesigned to highlight the [b]Storage[/b] and [b]Codex[/b] buttons, previously located near "Repair All." This new layout not only makes these buttons easier to access but also paves the way for future additions, such as a potential Hero Crafting button in later updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/0639a34e0dfd3a9e119b215809ef4044f82751c4.jpg[/img]

With all window buttons now grouped in one place, navigating your interface has never been easier. This redesign also leaves room for future expansions.

[h2]Ability & Perk Book UI Upgrade[/h2]

The [b]Ability[/b] and [b]Perk Book[/b] windows have received a visual and functional rework. With updated art, your character now stands at the center of the Perk Tree, enhancing the feeling of progression and customization.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/989db39b09467481401ff6cc399a2f5a644b3b7a.jpg[/img]

Switching between Perks and Abilities is now seamless, thanks to a clear toggle and a "new point" indicator that ensures you never miss an opportunity to upgrade.

[h2]Survival End Screen Improvements[/h2]

The updated [b]Survival End Screen[/b] now provides detailed information about your score, including a breakdown of the [b]difficulty multiplier[/b] and a new section for [b]Objectives[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/0cf2a6fd6b7a635d00d92ccce3e268122d2c0c5f.jpg[/img]

Destroying portals now properly reflects in your score, rewarding your efforts with a significant bonus.

[h2]Mod.io Integration![/h2]

For content creators and players seeking new scenarios, we’re excited to announce [b]mod.io integration[/b]! This platform allows you to browse, subscribe, and play custom scenarios directly in-game.

[b]Darfall on mod.io:[/b] https://mod.io/g/darfall


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/f941e0d1251f12d97581c4075bd3dcc90f14e4e8.jpg[/img]

Uploading your scenarios is as straightforward as using the Steam Workshop, and mod.io ensures that players can easily explore community creations.

[h2]Scenario Editor Improvements[/h2]

We’ve made several enhancements to the [b]Scenario Editor[/b], making it easier than ever to create your custom maps:

[h3]Custom Items with Icons[/h3]

You can now create custom items, assign names, and upload unique icons. Want a specific quest item to drop from Giant Rats? You can now make it happen!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/56790d8e8478a1701ce10686784ab09dc6c6e589.jpg[/img]

Custom items can be found in the Data Editor window on the second tab.

In the future, we also plan to add a way to modify any stat of an item, like Hitpoints or Damage, and to change existing items, like how much the Plank costs to craft.

[h3]Pathing Grid[/h3]

We have also added an option to display cells blocked by props or structures, helping you visualize AI navigation and player-building restrictions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/91fd287fd337a4ea42f0e1c986fb4d8752843524.jpg[/img]

[h3]Doodad Improvements[/h3]

Doodads serve as visual environment improvements and are designed to be non-interactable by the player in any way. However, we have added the ability to allow doodads to block pathing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/bce3ce4e12bb724d6ee0388b88322383e78616fe.jpg[/img]

This helps immensely when placing doodads like custom mountains or pillars, which previously allowed players to walk straight through them.

[h2]Full Update Notes[/h2]

These are just the highlights of what’s included in [b]0.10[/b]. For the complete list of fixes, improvements, and updates, check out the full changelist below:

[h2]0.10.0 Changelist[/h2]

[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Scenario Editor: You can now create custom items with your custom icons
[*] Added Mod.io integration. Upload, browse, download scenarios via mod.io platform
[/list]

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Scenario Editor: Doodads can now mark area as not walkable

notes.title: Play a new Darfall Demo - with new Graphics and Scenario Editor!
notes.content:
Hello Darfall Community!

It’s been a few months, and today we’re back with some news! We spent this time well, implementing the feedback we got from our last demo. Before we dive into details, including information on a new demo, have a look at this brand new trailer, and see if you can notice any difference!

[previewyoutube=EVBXlI9-hNA;full][/previewyoutube]
We’re happy to share that Darfall now has brand new visuals! We overhauled the game’s graphics into new, low-poly style. We hope you’ll enjoy defending your towns, and pushing back the darkness, with this new aesthetic!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/8ce2e0dd233094eb2d06b701344f9809dd037480.jpg[/img]
But that’s not all!

[h2]Play a new Darfall Demo now![/h2]

We have a brand new demo for you to try, starting today! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1961600/Darfall/

The demo is available right now, and comes with full graphical overhaul of the game, Survival Mode and one more surprise - a fully-imagined Scenario Editor, coming with Steam Workshop integration, so you can share your creations with other players!

[h2]Demo Features:[/h2]
Our new demo focuses on two of the three main pillars of the game - The Survival Mode and the Scenario Editor (We'll talk more about the Campaign later!). Read below to get a better idea of what to expect this time!

[h3]Survival Mode:[/h3]
The new Survival Mode comes with a number of brand new gameplay improvements:
[list]
[*][b]A new hero unit Ardan.[/b] An Aran’thal archmage with powerful abilities.
[*][b]Edgescar Survival Map. [/b]Our first survival map, set in the grassland biome.
[*][b]Nightly Undead Invasions[/b], with increasing challenges each night.
[*][b]Orc Raids[/b], that grow in intensity the richer and more prosperous your town becomes.
[*][b]Dark Pylon Waves[/b], which need to be proactively destroyed, to control the amount of enemy forces.
[*][b]Class-specific quests[/b] for the hero Ardan.
[*][b]Improved AI[/b], providing smarter enemies, formation and more.
[*][b]Exploration:[/b] Venture beyond your town to find treasures, events and other adventures.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/39c61d3bcdfaf0be684d65e5588697a3f6fca397.png[/img]

[h3]Scenario Editor:[/h3]
The brand new addition to Darfall - the Scenario Editor - comes with a number of features:
[list]
[*] [b]Terrain Editor:[/b] paint landscapes, raise mountains, place buildings, add special effects, and position units wherever you like.
[*] [b]Trigger Editor:[/b] Use a simple, sentence-based interface, define events, conditions, and actions to control what happens. Have a boss deliver a warning when you enter its lair, or command an orc army to march and attack—your storytelling is limitless.
[*] [b]Quest Editor:[/b] Create custom quests with objectives, subtasks, and markers that appear on the minimap or within the world.

[*] [b]Create Custom Items:[/b] Design unique items, from resources to hero equipment, and assign them custom icons. Bundle your creations with your scenario files, making it easy to share your custom gear, resources, and more with others.
[*] [b]Create Map Links:[/b] Want to design a campaign or epic RPG? Connect multiple scenarios, preserving player progress between them. Allow heroes to carry over items, levels or any custom variables from zone to zone, giving players a massive world with distinct biomes and quests.

Whether it’s a tower defense map, a puzzle, or an epic RPG across a vast continent, publish your scenario directly from the editor to steam workshop with just a few clicks—complete with a custom thumbnail from the game.

notes.title: DevBlog #14 - Main Menu Makeover, Loot Chests and Hero Quests
notes.content:
[h1]Hello everyone,[/h1]

It's me, Lukas, and in today's devblog, we're excited to share insights into the redesign of the main menu, the introduction of new loot chests and their mechanics, and the introduction of hero class-specific quests!

[h2]Main Menu[/h2]

Our main menu redesign aims to set the tone for Darfall, capturing the essence of our world through both visuals and music. We envisioned the menu as an “iconic” view that immediately immerses you into the game's atmosphere.

[h3]The Portal[/h3]

Initially, we explored the idea of a demonic portal, visualizing the invasion's onset. This concept featured an army of demons pouring out, set against the backdrop of Darfall Wastes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/e97de0367fec283cafb737427f3651c5000e6070.jpg[/img]

You can see the initial sketches, then the 3d model and finally how would it look like in the menu.

While looking amazing, even though this was far from final art, we wanted to try another perspective, which would more capture the actual gameplay and main goal of the game.

[h3]City Under Siege[/h3]

Our next idea brought the focus to a city under siege by the undead.

This direction required experimenting with various architectural designs to find the right fit for Darfall, exploring different perspectives to achieve a balance between scale and detail.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/3c5ed52c02e6d9c8071624c7e8a81913f966a791.jpg[/img]

We then needed to capture the best point of view, to create a sense of scale, while being able to show off the undead army.

You can see we even modelled the entire scene, this is so we can dynamically adjust the camera to check all of the angles, which would be very problematic with concept art only, as you need to redraw basically entire scene each time you want to try a new perspective.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/a74b0ad2ba6e4c76f39930ca64f5c2350018809c.jpg[/img]

The final product, thanks to Dalibor's exceptional talent, not only showcases a city fighting against the undead but also embodies Darfall's color palette of blue, orange, and purple.

This, combined with the main theme music and dynamic menu animations, aims to be a memorable first impression for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/9ddd798f71559c8458ff5e7eb5e5e8cccd396e0f.jpg[/img]

[h2]Hero Class Quests[/h2]

We're also introducing unique quests for each hero class to enhance their distinctiveness and provide engaging objectives within survival maps.

Each hero has one unique quest that can be completed on any survival map, the quest always fits the thematic of that hero.

[h3]Magus[/h3]

For the Magus class, exemplified by our main character Ardan, the quest involves a corrupted obelisk that you must cleanse using your magical abilities.

This mission tests your ability to defend against demonic assaults while maintaining your focus on the obelisk. Moving out of obelisk area will decrease the quest progress, so stay close!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/2ccc5ec5fbd2f24241fa89cd401d56af7162d63a.jpg[/img]

[h3]Slayer[/h3]

Kalen, our Slayer, faces a formidable demon lord powered by demonic sigils.

You must disrupt this power sources, facing lesser demons after each sigil, before confronting the demon lord himself and having a “nice conversion” with him (using your Greataxe).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/da1bf8dad0438a59a406cad3fd2fb67b75c70f20.jpg[/img]

[h3]Ranger[/h3]

Nariel, the Ranger, is tasked with finding and purifying a mutated ancient tree and its guardian.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/f190823db1db77ae22d17f79a7c223ebeb2cc54d.jpg[/img]

Then you need to track the beast and end its misery. But be prepared, it won’t be an easy fight.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/14eab8c67df186ec3f162610608ce2012608d61d.jpg[/img]

[h3]Quest Design[/h3]

You can also see behind the scenes into the initial design of all 3 quests done in Figma. As with any mechanics, we always design the concepts in whiteboard first to get the flow and details down before actual implementations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/b7c63c613b5fed7094f6fb14ce9504068e6e2f30.jpg[/img]

[h2]Treasure Chests[/h2]

To add depth to the looting mechanics, we've introduced three tiers of treasure chests: Poor (Gray), Fine (Green), and Epic (Purple), each offering loot of varying quality and difficulty to access.

[h3]Nature Chests[/h3]

These forgotten chests, found throughout the map, require keys for access, which can be discovered in monster camps or crafted, adding a layer of strategy to your exploration.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/dd64b70734c2ea8f0726197bb6f098c94a1ca6da.jpg[/img]

[h3]Orc Chests[/h3]

Protected by orc warbands, these chests vary in difficulty, with the most valuable ones located within heavily guarded orc fortifications, challenging you to engage with fort defences and orc warlord in combat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/047db335312f6f0c05f2f2af62a1976c8e9c57bf.jpg[/img]

[h3]Undead Chests[/h3]

Situated in undead territories, these chests demand a resource sacrifice for their treasures, introducing a tough decision-making aspect to your looting strategy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/9a10c7129a8487f3e0457e294ee992c0728f99b8.jpg[/img]

You can pick any of 3 resources offered you wish to sacrifice, which will open the chest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/a8c33a039367a56a9b1d876eebe2cbec9a13570d.jpg[/img]

To make the exploration more interesting and reduce the amount of times you need to return to base to heal up or get energy, there will be also rare spawns of healing and energy fountains.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/48a11cc5ff881264022c37627573899fa2624cef.jpg[/img]

There are many, many new additions to mechanics and map features, but we want to leave some also for the next devblogs, right?

[h3]Visit in Paradox Interactive HQ[/h3]

Lastly, we had the pleasure of visiting Paradox Interactive HQ in Stockholm, discussing Darfall's future and how we can make it the ultimate RPG city-building experience for you.

However, we all got surprised by sudden snow haha! 😃

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/ca03bbaf39047db7e8e837410a47cb34ac89b465.jpg[/img]

Thanks for reading this update. We're eager to share more with you in our next devblogs.

Lukas and rest of the team from beyond the darkness of Darfall

notes.title: DevBlog #13 - Hero Perks
notes.content:
Welcome to the 13th installment of our devblog, Paladins of Aganor! It’s me Lukas, and today we're diving into the inspiration behind, and the current iteration of, the hero perk system.

In case you missed it, don't forget to check out our previous [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1961600/view/3863588843590713513?l=english]devblog #12[/url], where we delved into the intricacies of the newly reworked survival map, showcasing its enhancements and difficulty options.

[h2]Perk System Overview[/h2]

Our current perk system represents a pivotal aspect of hero customization. It consists of various nodes that you can unlock using perk points. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/4f272a6155f49ffb9ff9cd1af2f66bc5a8dd4259.png[/img]

These nodes offer a range of enhancements - from health and damage boosts to the exciting possibility of doubling loot drops (yes, double legendary drops if you are super lucky!). They even allow heroes to directly mine resources like iron or silver.

For those interested for more behind the scenes technical info, I have also created a coding session with implementation in Unity:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2eQ9XHY99Jo

[h3]Earning Perk Points[/h3]

We've designed multiple avenues for accumulating perk points to allow diverse strategic approaches:

- Leveling up a hero grants +1 perk point.
- Using the 'Book of Knowledge' item from the inventory also adds +1 perk point.
- This valuable book drops from defeating elite or boss enemies.
- Additionally, the 'Book of Knowledge' can be crafted in the new Library building, which consumes mana orbs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/0d4adbbab2924e8a7a81d5d3d86424dcc36aa291.png[/img]

Our aim is to provide you with a variety of strategies and sources to acquire these points.

[h2]From Concept to Reality[/h2]

[h3]Initial Design Stage[/h3]

In the early design phase, depicted in Figma, the focus was not only on the node visuals but also on the mechanics of acquiring them. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/a913cc2f52cddadabcd8dc799de7f7af4f2ee2ab.png[/img]

Initially, I considered a progression system where performing specific actions with heroes, like resource gathering or enemy combat, would level up related skills. However, this concept often leads to a grinding routine seen in other RPGs, such as Albion Online, and didn't seem to fit a strategy game with city-building elements.

[h3]Final Design Choice[/h3]

Ultimately, I decided on a more straightforward approach: unrestricted perk points that you can assign freely. This decision steers clear of grinding and offers flexibility in character development.

[h3]Inspiration and Future Expansion[/h3]

A major source of inspiration for our perk system is the intricate passive tree from Path of Exile, renowned for its depth and complexity. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/09363bc8b72b5dfc526412e9c571449f0c968dc4.png[/img]

This model offers us the exciting potential to continually expand our system. We can add more ranks to existing nodes, like health or damage boosts, or introduce entirely new enhancements to further grow our hero's capabilities.

Stay tuned for more updates and insights in our upcoming devblogs!

- Lukas from beyond the darkness of Darfall

notes.title: DevBlog #12 - Survival Map and Difficulties
notes.content:
Welcome back, Darfall enthusiasts, to our 12th devblog! It's Lukas here, ready to dive into the latest enhancements we've made to the survival world map of Aganor, as well as introduced difficulty options into the game.

[h1]Introducing the World Map[/h1]

In a shift from the typical UI dropdowns seen in similar genre games, we've embraced a world map approach for our survival mode. This decision isn't just about a fresh gameplay experience; it's about laying the foundation for the expansive Darfall universe, complete with its diverse races, sprawling landmasses, and iconic cities.

Below is our initial world map design, crafted using Incarnate. While this version won't feature in the game directly, it's a crucial step for us developers in shaping Aganor's geography before its digital implementation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/e30ba682eadd118df93d7026d885a7e61cbcbb7f.png[/img]

For lore enthusiasts, this map is more than just a tool - it's a window into the world of Darfall. You can trace the paths our heroes have taken and the sites of pivotal events that have shaped our universe.

As for the Darfall Wastes' mysterious northern reaches, we're keeping that under wraps for now. Rest assured, it's a region teeming with perils and rich in lore, with plenty of surprises in store as we advance the game's story through the campaign mode.

[h1]Mapping in 3D[/h1]

Our world map's evolution is ongoing, but here's a sneak peek at its current form in Magica Voxel. This tool is our go-to for everything from terrain modeling to creating trees and units.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/fcffff19e63267431f4a8fd69f1dc8fc1479fcac.jpg[/img]

A big shoutout to Jany, our talented freelance artist, who's spearheading the 3D modeling of the world map.

[h1]Introducing Difficulty Settings[/h1]

We're upping the game with adjustable difficulty levels, offering new challenges for every player.

Before launching a map, you can select from three difficulty options:

- [b]Easy:[/b] Enemies at 80% standard damage and health. Score multiplier: 1x.
- [b]Medium:[/b] Default setting with enemies at 100% damage and health. Score multiplier: 1.2x.
- [b]Hard:[/b] Unlocks after a medium difficulty victory. Enemies have 130% damage and health. Score multiplier: 1.5x.

And here's a glimpse at the revamped hero selection, map choice, objectives, and difficulty screen:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/3ba3a5aab7c8da82c4046766a738369545ca415e.png[/img]

[h1]City Location Updates[/h1]

We've repositioned cities on the world map for clarity and alignment with the new continental layout. This change not only clarifies your progression path but also integrates seamlessly with the updated map. 

Now, you can also view the survival days required for each map, adding another layer of strategy to your gameplay.

(Please keep in mind, the bellow model is work-in-progress and does not represent the final version)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/9ecc61992766fa3f3e67712c741015295c9aa6b3.png[/img]

Stay tuned for more updates, where we will go over the new Perk System and thanks for being part of our Darfall journey!

- Lukas from beyond the darkness of Darfall.

notes.title: DevBlog #11 - Biome Features
notes.content:
Hello, everyone! 

It's me Lukas and I’m excited to delve into the biome features that are in the works for our Early Access release. Our aim is not only to offer visual diversity across biomes, but also to enrich gameplay by introducing unique challenges and interactive environments.

The three starting Early Access biomes are:

1. [b]Grassland[/b]
2. [b]Desert[/b]
3. [b]Swamp[/b]

Each biome is designed to offer more than just eye candy, they integrate unique natural obstacles or events that compel you to adapt your gameplay strategies.

[h1]Grassland - Navigate Through Storms[/h1]

In the Grassland biome, prepare yourself for heavy storms, accompanied by rain, fog, and lightning. These weather conditions are random and will sporadically occur as you progress through the map.

- [b]Lightning Strikes[/b]: Not only do these add a visual spectacle, but they can also be dangerous for your city. Lightning can strike randomly across the map, causing damage to whatever it hits.
- [b]Spread of Fire[/b]: To make things more challenging, lightning strikes can ignite fires. These fires will spread and last for a certain duration, posing a risk to both units and structures in their path. Fire damage is currently mild, as there's no fire defense mechanism in place. We plan on evolving fire mechanics in future updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/3d7e2caafde32eb6854e03314ad43e3d8bb0eff3.png[/img]

[h2]More about Fire[/h2]

Fire will play a larger role in the game. Our plans involve allowing you to use fire as an additional defensive line by igniting a flammable surface, such as oil, just before the undead wave reaches you.

One scene that comes to mind is the famous Battle of Winterfell in Game of Thrones, for those of you who have watched it:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/da808d0e2bc58f6fa4faea7b7783a30902f5d9b1.png[/img]

In Darfall, each tile and object has a flammable level, which determines how quickly fire can spread to that tile if there is already a fire nearby. For example, grass tile has a flammable level of 1, while in the desert, it may be just 0.5, preventing the spread of fire on sand.

To recreate a flame wall similar to Game of Thrones, we can introduce buildable flammable oil tiles with a high flammable level, such as 10. Igniting just one of these tiles will rapidly spread the fire to the rest of the connected oil tiles.

Here is a quick preview of some flame wall tests we plan to integrate into the game in the future:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/eb3fe8854f8af5f7cf3f003bb14548ad1d053761.png[/img]

So for now, the only way how the fire can be created is via lightning strikes, as there are still unanswered design questions regarding the fire, particularly how to ignite it and how to combat it when it spreads into your city. 

Any ideas will be much appreciated! Feel free to share them on our [url=https://discord.gg/bsdVf4ZYm2]Discord[/url].

[h1]Desert - Survive the Heat Waves[/h1]

The desert biome has its own environmental obstacle: heatwaves. At any moment, the temperature can soar, affecting your workers' efficiency.

- [b]Adapting to Heat[/b]: You can counter the impact of heatwaves by crafting specific building upgrades—a refreshing mug of beer for your workers. This innovative mechanism will negate the adverse effects of the heatwave entirely for that structure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/2a5411b904d4526d157843dc3ef45ee248315717.jpg[/img]

[h1]Swamp - Tread Carefully Through Mud[/h1]

In the Swamp biome, mud is the primary natural obstacle. Although it doesn't trigger like other events, mud patches are present right from the start.

- [b]Reduced Mobility[/b]: These mud patches slow down the movement speed of any unit—friend or foe—that crosses them.
- [b]Counteracting Mud[/b]: You can build roads over these patches to eliminate the slowdown effect. Road construction becomes a strategic necessity in this biome.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/45186fa58f9bed079589c9a599f0540f92414456.png[/img]

[h2]What's Next?[/h2]

That sums up the features of our initial three biomes. Post Early Access, expect to see even more biomes, each teeming with its own set of unique features and challenges.

So, stay tuned for more exciting updates from us!
- Lukas

notes.title: Big News: Team Up with a Publisher!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

This is Lukas, and we have some exciting news to share with you today. Darfall is about to embark on a thrilling new journey as we enter into a collaboration with a publisher. While we can't reveal the publisher's name just yet, we promise to unveil this exciting partnership in the coming months. What we can tell you is that this collaboration will bring about significant changes, transforming Darfall into an even more immersive and polished experience.

As a gamer myself, I've had the privilege of playing many titles from this publisher, and can tell you I'm a huge fan. This partnership is a dream come true, and I can assure you that you won't be disappointed. Together, we're committed to elevating Darfall to new heights.

Currently, we've set our sights on an Early Access release in Q1 2024. We acknowledge that news of a release delay may not be everyone's preference. Yet, we stand firmly behind the belief that ensuring a polished and immersive product is well worth the wait. After all, you can only launch a game once!

This collaboration opens up exciting opportunities for us to enhance Darfall in various ways. It enables us to invest in crucial aspects such as localization, creating bespoke music and sound effects in partnership with sound studios, and refining animations or particle effects to enrich your gaming experience.

Over the next few months, we'll be sharing more updates as we work diligently to bring you an even better Darfall. Our focus is on delivering more content and improvements to the game before its Early Access release.

Thank you for your unwavering support. This collaboration marks a new chapter in Darfall's development, and we can't wait to share the incredible journey ahead with all of you.

Stay tuned for more exciting updates, and let's make Darfall's future brighter than ever.

Warm regards,
Lukas and Martin from beyond the darkness of Darfall.

notes.title: DevBlog #10 - Huntsman Hero
notes.content:
Hello everyone and welcome to our [b]10th Darfall update[/b].

We are proud to unveil the last Early Access hero, the Huntsman.

If you missed the last devblog about the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1961600/announcements/detail/3666539867355892646]Archmage hero[/url], go and take a peak.

[h1]Huntsman[/h1]

The Huntsman is master at bows and hunting. He has various utilities at his disposal, that can also help you get food in less hospitable maps.

Huntsman has no armor penetration or armor, but he makes it up in long range attacks and high damage. He can also summon animal companions you can control, which also contribute to his defense and attacks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/58040c0f0dd029f4eefc6e9b42724d473e06abce.png[/img]

[h2]Abilities[/h2]

[h3]The first ability is the Piercing Shot[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/003272f1cb8d21cb10a303496ddf0391b37101fe.png[/img]

Very good at both single target, as well as multi target if you aim it right.

[h3]For area of damage, we have Arrow Rain[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/081e3f7ee3cd8db8f010f4f1b1ed399c1d490518.png[/img]

This is a skill based ability, as arrows rain from a sky after some delay, so you better aim it right. But once the arrows hit, the damage is high.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/b84287ae6b9bbf6a6efab3c28ce3521e75b53b86.png[/img]

[h3]The next ability is the Feral Ally[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/99222ec30ff1ca63152044fdd58ab69d30301dbc.png[/img]

This defines the Huntsman and makes him currently the only hero who can summon units. The first animal is the Direwolf. If you upgrade this ability, you can summon a sturdy bear with high hitpoints.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/733cf0ff38e70cfeb961dfd45a56d999d414cf6d.png[/img]

In the last upgrade you can summon a Lion, powerful unit that deals some heavy damage to its enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/adbc3d3072ac3273cbde4076998beb06cef1df03.png[/img]

[h3]Another ability is the Poison Arrow[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/91b41097a935d43374d18a8a32f2a1e02da7fac8.png[/img]

Excels at single target damage and ignores armor completely, so you better pick it against those sturdy elites.

[h3]The next area of effect ability is Paralyzing Gas[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/1e95e64832d6fb5bae87bd8c2ec3993466fc9eff.png[/img]

This stinky gas disorients enemies while they take moderate damage.

[h3]The last ability is Feral Trap[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/4cc461f92dc8a02a941d8ed356b081bb6a134c09.png[/img]

You can place as many traps as you want, so you can prepare a path of death for those invading undead.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/d30c8d9060996af058f92c238c132fc98b57ba65.png[/img]

When placed in the wilderness, you can trap animals to gain food in less hospitable biomes.

This is the end of today's devblog. We hope that playing with the Huntsman will make you feel like a real hunter thanks to his useful abilities.

If you're waiting for more content, don't forget to [b]WISHLIST[/b] the Prologue version we're currently working on.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2306730/Darfall_Prologue/

Lukas and Martin from beyond the graveyards of Darfall.

notes.title: DevBlog #9 - Archmage Hero
notes.content:
Hello everyone and welcome to our [b]9th Darfall update[/b]. It's me Lukas and today I’m going to show you the the new [b]Archmage[/b] hero.

Also don’t forget to take a look at the previous [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1961600/view/3721704616619976354?l=english]Axemaster devblog[/url] if you missed it.

[h1]Archmage[/h1]

You all know the [b]Archmage[/b] from the current Demo. He is a mage-class hero thats wield magic and shoots projectiles from afar.

The [b]Archmage[/b] excels at crown control and area damage, so pick him if you want to clear large hordes of invading undead.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/8b962abc7c0d834f0d103ddaf3a9955818b7bc25.png[/img]

The [b]Archmage[/b], being the only hero magic wielder as of now, has magic resistance, meaning it receives reduced magical damage, which is heavily used by hard hitting necromancers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/a1c0e63bdc76eef50faba4f45a0e0d33f4233204.png[/img]

The [b]Archmage[/b] also has an armor penetration, since magic can penetrate armor, so its also good at dealing with armored elites.

[h2]Abilities[/h2]

As we have changed how the spell book works in the new version of the game, you can try out all the 6 abilities by picking 3, then resetting them each 24h for free if you change your mind or want to pick a different build.

[h3]One of the first abilities you all love is the well known Fireball[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/529e44cbeab23f0ddf500ece4c1a04c727463b4f.png[/img]

This is the best single target ability when you want to melt your target fast.

[h3]The next ability is the Frost Ray[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/de497264b9b82a6da1599192423735cda004673e.png[/img]

This literally blasts all enemies in front of the hero and can control large crowds of enemies at once.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/efc72c2954f4d3d6faa367196fc38527981811a8.png[/img]

[h3]Another ability is the Fire Circle[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/a62248e7daab65bfe1667db1b3f510a79fd94f8e.png[/img]

Another great area damage ability for those large hordes of stupid undead.

[h3]If you wanna stop all your enemies, there is a Freezing Nova[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/be0fed8c9b3e3f05595613f6f47e7f5563b0f9cb.png[/img]

Crowd control ability that can freeze an entire horde of enemies in place. Combine it with Fire Circle and Frost Ray and you can only imagine the effect this will have on those poor undead.

[h3]The second last ability is the Healing Circle[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/1e65a0252a55407e4403c3273448a91c461bdc59.png[/img]

This is one of two support abilities that can heal up your friendly units when you are out in the wild and exploring.

[h3]And the last ability is the Arcane Strength[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/df414de07bc0ae63e1f32d0aa94d713984482420.png[/img]

The second support ability if you want to empower your units to deal the maximum damage.

I hope you liked the mixture of the abilities that can offer different styles of gameplay during your survival.



See you in the next debvblog post, where we will reveal the last mystery hero.

If you're waiting for more content, don't forget to [b]WISHLIST[/b] the Prologue version we're currently working on.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2306730/Darfall_Prologue/

Lukas and Martin from beyond the graveyards of Darfall.

notes.title: DevBlog #8 - Axemaster Hero
notes.content:
Hello everyone and welcome to our 8th Darfall update. It's me Lukas and today I’m going to show you the new [b]Axemaster[/b] hero.

We hope you enjoyed the latest [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1961600/view/3721704616619897234?l=english]Prologue[/url] update, where we included all the new features coming to the Prologue version of the game, like demons or unit upgrades.

[h1]Axemaster[/h1]

The Axemaster is a melee expert who wields a greataxe to slash enemies in half.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/aa99cb7303f86aa8e9d1c5e38d165682cf22634f.png[/img]

This hero has an [b]armor penetration[/b] stat that allows him to ignore enemy armor completely.

To elaborate more on the armor mechanics: if an enemy has the [b]armor[/b] stat, any physical damage dealt to them is reduced by 30%. This means your archers or spearmen will deal less damage, which is represented by gray damage numbers in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/31a0c1780e0a2086c27a58d5695d1f849729b353.png[/img]

However, as the Axemaster has [b]armor penetration[/b], it will deal full damage to enemies wearing armor as orc elites or warlords.

As an Axemaster is a heavy hero unit, it also wears [b]armor[/b]. This means any enemies will deal 30% less damage to him, making him great at soaking damage and being first in the fight.

[h1]Abilities[/h1]

One of the first abilities is the [b]Power Strike[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/9630623c964c1f5cf6aaa3f639e0c422f1eaa137.png[/img]

This makes it a good single target dealing ability, which eviscerates the enemies.

The next ability is the [b]Cleave[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/9e3952ec430081fc9700fc55ed7f14051b266641.png[/img]

This is the only AOE ability you can pick. This makes the Axemaster more single target focused hero than the rest.

Another ability is the [b]Charge[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/2777583ac109197c5766efca64fbc8b2847074ac.png[/img]

This makes sure you are the first in combat to wreak havoc in the middle of your enemies.

When you are low on health, there is a [b]Bloodthirst[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/e7fb18a88dde931301c33f4f98cc4846ac8179df.png[/img]

This can heal the Axemaster as long as he deals damage, making an aggressive play more rewarding.

The last ability is [b]Harden[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/8eda06f27e8841d52d620f1283623e24827b9f47.png[/img]

In case you want to make your Axemaster more “tanky”, you definitely want to pick this ability.

This concludes today's devblog. We hope that fans of heavy-hitting warrior-type heroes will not be disappointed.

notes.title: DevBlog #7 - Bags, Fishing and More!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/d0c7c0f57fe2c092e10db2d0a6d68197a78f8e0c.png[/img]

Hello everyone and welcome to our 7th Darfall update. It's me Lukas and we are going to look at what we have been up to since our last devlog and what are our future plans.

We also hope you enjoyed the last [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1961600/view/3666526100980821852?l=english]World Map Update[/url], where we showed you some details about our continent of Aganor and how the survival mode plays on this map.

[h1]What We Have Been Up To?[/h1]

Over the past few weeks, we've dedicated most of our efforts to preparing the demo for release by addressing bugs and enhancing the player experience with quality-of-life improvements. So if you haven't downloaded Darfall demo yet, don't hesitate and play it now yourself.

In addition to development work, we've also been actively engaging in marketing efforts by participating in events like Steam Next Fest and Builder Fest. While these activities can be time-consuming, we recognize their importance in building awareness and excitement for the game.

We're thrilled to have recently launched the public Steam Demo, which allows players to experience Darfall for themselves for up to six days (or even up to eight days for more experienced players). We hope that this demo will give players a taste of the exciting city-building and strategy gameplay that Darfall has to offer.

(You can see the score of one of our [url=https://discord.gg/Pz9kpaQ88b]Discord[/url] players, [b]Pattat[/b], quite impressive, right?)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/cabb3eed2726b04b24a68e8ef20c2ad1ac1b74fa.png[/img]

You can compare your own score on our [url=https://discord.gg/Pz9kpaQ88b]Discord[/url] as well!

We're thrilled with the positive feedback the demo has received from players. We're collecting and using valuable feedback via our in-game system to improve the game for our upcoming Early Access release later this year. 

We've decided to keep the demo available to give players more time to try it out and provide additional feedback. We're excited to continue working on Darfall with the help of our community.

h the help of our community.

[h1]Backpacks - More, more and more items![/h1]

We've recently introduced a new feature to the game that allows players to craft backpacks at their Tailor building. These backpacks can be equipped on your hero, boosting their carrying capacity and reducing the need to return to base after a successful loot run.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/235e0cf55f4b976719e3fb4561e3a09d65acd71a.png[/img]

With this new addition, players can now explore the game world more efficiently, collecting more resources and items without worrying about running out of inventory space. 

We hope this feature will improve the overall gameplay experience and encourage players to venture further into the game's world.

[h1]Fishing[/h1]

Fishing has been a highly requested feature, and we're excited to announce that it will be available in the next update. With the Fishing Hut building, players can catch fish for an alternate source of food, particularly useful on maps with reduced farm production.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/84fef6d7f6e4604b4f73e75d98ba3fd4e53e6d47.jpg[/img]

Simply locate fishing schools in bodies of water, and employ a worker as a fisherman by building a Fishing Hut nearby. We can't wait to see how this new feature enhances gameplay.

[h1]Biomes - Desert and Swamp[/h1]

The work is slowly starting on our 2 new biomes, Desert and Swamps, which will provide a refreshing change from the grassland biome. Our goal is to make each biome feel unique, with different strategies required to gather food, resources and fend off enemies.

For example, on desert maps, food will be scarce, so players will need to collect special fruits or catch fish in rare oases to feed their units. However, stone and iron will be abundant, making it easier to mine, build, and craft.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/bf6c7fc7d13500fcb5c2e7ea96a0d04a6ca0b8e5.jpg[/img]

We're excited to see how players will adapt to these new challenges and are looking forward to sharing more details about these biomes in the future.

[h1]More Technical Details[/h1]

For developers and Unity3D enthusiasts, I'd like to share some technical details about our project. We've been working hard to rewrite and improve many background systems to increase performance and make the architecture more robust for the future.

[h3]Terrain Generation[/h3]

One of the changes we've made is to our terrain generation system, where we're generating chunks and meshes for the game. Part of the code is run through Unity's new job system, which has helped to improve performance. However, we've been revisiting this code as we believe that stuttering may have been caused by this system, particularly when corrupted tiles change into grass and the terrain needs to regenerate.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/2ca996c7b4b0e4cdebc296fda566c8f720daa782.png[/img]

Overall, we're committed to delivering a high-quality gaming experience, and we'll continue to optimize our systems and code to ensure that players can enjoy the game without any issues.

[h3]User Interface Refactor[/h3]

In addition to the technical updates, we've also made some improvements to the user interface. Previously, all of our UI was in a single scene, which was difficult to navigate due to the large number of objects. It was also a mess, which made it challenging to manage.

(As you can see, all of the UI is in a single scene, bunched together)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/27838ca652cafe4f839c5fa73378cbaa4c0788a9.png[/img]

To address this issue, I have refactored our UI and separated all of the UI parts into separate "widget" prefabs, such as the inventory, minimap, build section or top bar. This has significantly reduced the complexity of adding or changing UI elements, and has made the scene much faster to load.

(example of ability book widget)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/c2e9cdd5a703993087e5d4aba412112b5e38fc95.png[/img]

[h3]Project Structure[/h3]

We've also made some changes to the naming convention of the asset files we're using in the game. To improve organization and ease of use, we followed the guidelines outlined in the Unity Style Guide found [url=https://github.com/justinwasilenko/Unity-Style-Guide]here[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/40ba6a37bcc4bb22ae8cc9296cb9f51c32a67c3e.png[/img]

By using this guide, we were able to create clear asset prefixes and group similar assets together. For example, we now use "SM_" for static mesh and "T_" for texture. As a result, our assets are now much easier to find and access.

For instance, we've grouped all of the assets related to the Knight unit, such as its mesh, icon, blueprint, and prefab, into a single folder, making it more convenient for our team to locate them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/0fa3889a13167ef84dead56d979fc180462ce33f.png[/img]

These changes may seem small, but they have greatly improved our development process, and we believe they will enhance the overall quality of the game.

[h1]Prologue[/h1]

We also have a Prologue Steam Page up you can check out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2306730/Darfall_Prologue/

Add to your [b]WISHLIST[/b], as a prologue version will be released before Early Access with additional features you can play beforehand.


Thanks for reading, and we can't wait to see you in the game!

Martin and Lukas from beyond the darkness of Darfall.

notes.title: DevBlog #6 - World Map
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/3df237756b98053b16228dd9350e7628b586caa8.png[/img]

Hello everyone and welcome to our 6th Darfall update. It's me Lukas and today I’m going to show you the world map for the game.

We hope you enjoyed the last [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1961600/view/3638375250988625294?l=english]Legendary Items Update[/url], where we explained how the various legendary powers can be obtained within the Darfall.

We're excited to share with you a more detailed look at the development of the survival world map for our game, which takes place on a part of the continent known as [b]Aganor[/b]. The survival map is an integral part of our game, allowing players to test their skills and endurance as they fight against waves of enemy attacks.

To begin, we prototyped various ideas for how a survival mode in our game might look. Our first idea was to have a series of tiles, each representing a different biome and level of difficulty, that would unlock as players survived through previous tiles. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/41e302e839b75e3b2823bd3b08630f7440a87dcb.png[/img]

But we wanted to incorporate more lore and world-building into Darfall, so we decided to go with a full continent map where players would have to fight their way through increasingly difficult parts of the map.

Initially, we thought about creating a 2D map in the style of classical maps you might find in other games. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/32efe5512eb065fe5a87a5cb512d21e964edc7d6.png[/img]

However, we quickly realised that a 2D map wouldn't allow us to include the kind of effects, animations, and depth we wanted to achieve. So, we decided to go with a full 3D map instead.

(Me drawing a rough shape and outline of the map and its locations)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/d220a7ff5902a70c3ffc49fca682f44d31413721.png[/img]

Using Magica Voxel, a 3D modeling software, and Adobe Fresco, we drew a rough outline of the landmass and its various biomes, including forests, mountains, and deserts. We also gave each location and place a unique name to help immerse players in the game world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/8ee89a9e308f8e0fafa1d8a77f8e0fa6e9b0d284.png[/img]

Martin then created the first version of the world using these designs. After several iterations, we brought the map into the editor and added locations, models, and particles like clouds to add to the overall atmosphere.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/42105f5d165fb2cca7b190030a29b2a94e148e06.png[/img]

This is how the map looks currently before the demo release. It's still a work in progress, but it's shaping up nicely. As you can see, the survival map only covers a part of the continent. The rest of the continent, including the capital, will be part of the campaign mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/e6ba0be58ccdb12d56f6df50d27d18def3780d32.jpg[/img]

In the game, players start in Grimwick, located on the northwest point of the map. This is the first map players are tasked with attacking, rebuilding, and purging of undead corruption. As players progress through the map and complete each area, new biomes and locations will unlock, each with their own level of difficulty. Each biome - grassland, desert, and swamp - has three maps, representing three levels of difficulty (normal, hard, and very hard).

Creating the survival map was a challenging but rewarding process. We hope that players enjoy exploring the various biomes and locations on the map and testing their skills against the undead.

Thanks for reading, and we can't wait to see you in the game!

Martin and Lukas from beyond the darkness of Darfall.

notes.title: DevBlog #4 - AI
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/0f8051dea65706fad4bb793f3384413ed30959ef.png[/img]

Hello everyone and welcome back :)

It's me Lukas and today I will talk about how the AI (Artificial Intelligence) works in Darfall and what we use in the background to drive it.

At the very early stages of the development, the AI for our units was quite simple, like moving to a position, or attacking a target. I wrote this behavior in pure code with my own implementation, but it turned out to be super messy and unreadable quite fast. Even such a simple AI behaviors takes A LOT of code to write.

Later on I tried to research what other tool I could use for our AI. I came across Behavior Designer, the most popular AI asset on the Unity asset store. In the Behavior Designer, you put nodes on a visual graph and depending on how you place and connect your nodes, it will create AI logic you desire.

[h1]Simple Tree[/h1]

Here is a very simple node example, showing how the AI waits for some time, then picks a random position and walks towards it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/9e3d1864a3d073e44d1a9ee281915fd35ace4e67.jpg[/img]

You could probably deduct what these nodes do even if I did not explain the logic behind them. This is why having a visual tree such as Behavior Designer helps immensely during the AI development and navigating its different parts.

[h1]Woodcutter AI[/h1]

The following tree shows a small example part of the woodcutter AI. The nodes are evaluated from left to right, where left nodes have the highest priority and always try to execute first.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/49627f5c6d207e12fa65a0f4654b887caa5e2faa.jpg[/img]

[b]1. Do we have any resource to carry? [/b]
- If yes, carry it to storage
- If not, continue to the next node segment 2.

[b]2. Have we found any resource to gather? [/b]
- If yes, move towards it and gather it
- If not, continue to the next segment 3.

[b]3. Wander around aimlessly until the worker faints out from exhaustion :D[/b]

[h1]Player Unit AI[/h1]

Here is another example, a full tree that represents the AI behind the player warrior units:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/550ded0f5fd718bb2a5fed39fa30253f6ed58072.jpg[/img]

You can see how complex this can get very quickly even with a such visual tool :) 
Now you can imagine how hard would it be to write all this AI logic in pure code, without any visual tree representation.

The AI is usually the most challenging feat to handle during any game development. I had to rewrite the entire AI in Darfall for several times already, using different approaches or plugins, such as NodeCanvas.

I'm happy how it turned out and that Behavior Designer trees were a good choice, reducing future bugs, or making it much easier to implement new AI logic like possible boss fighting mechanics.

See you in the next dev blog post.

All the best,
Martin and Lukas from Play Square Games

notes.title: DevBlog #3 - Map Generation
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/c35d8031bfad532d1a277f2fef690d28378b9dde.png[/img]

Hello everyone and welcome back :)

It's me Lukas and today I will talk about how the map is generated in Darfall.

Since maps in Darfall are procedurally generated, we needed a versatile system that would allow us to modify any part of the map generation, like which trees are placed into the forests, what areas will our forests cover, or what units and structures are generated into which parts of the map.

This system is fully "scriptable", this means that Martin, our artist, can modify any part of the map generation without me needing to touch the code.

[h2]Grassland Map[/h2]

Let's start with few steps of how the [b]Grassland[/b] map is generated. First, an empty body of water is placed onto the map

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/8fc1de9a9e8e0b3e12b6378c125e64207082ddca.jpg[/img]

Next, the terrain tiles are generated, with mountains and bodies of water. Both use perlin noise to make them look natural.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/e21f31fadf9d7d321de13f05af719b42ddb1bf14.jpg[/img]

Then resources like trees and iron veins are placed into the map. Trees are also generated using perlin noise, which gives the tree clusters more natural look.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/0360a4f55f07d704ce53564e5e79537c4193df18.jpg[/img]

Finally, enemy camps are placed into valid locations, like orc camps or undead zones

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/49f61afebc54e7445b54554dfffb4cf291ac9f05.jpg[/img]

[h2]Camps[/h2]

Any enemy "point of interest" location is called a camp. These are also procedurally generated. We have a simple system that allows us to quickly populate these camps with props and loot in the Unity editor without touching the code.

Some simple examples of orc camp can be seen here:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/2fcc8981069c2b31ea2c07b30c18dc3d28a1337e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/7c9f511b7907dd20b7bcaa6313bea50a333cc443.jpg[/img]

All these tools allow us to create quite an impressive locations, like undead zones which create an atmosphere of dangerous corrupted lands

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/c85cf03c6fa42b6b567315c547fa90b5e601b474.jpg[/img]

Above were just quick examples of the processes we currently have in its initial stages. In the future, we plan to generate entire villages, forts or encampments for different races, that will be present across different map biomes.

I hope you liked this quick sneak peak of how Darfall is generating its map :)

See you in the next dev blog post!

All the best,
Martin and Lukas from Play Square Games

notes.title: DevBlog #2 - Menu Improvements
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/5bbe9498880e33f68ece655f78eaf20c845145c5.png[/img]

Hello everyone and welcome back :)

Today, we want to show you the work we have done on the Main Menu in the past weeks. It was not the only improvement to the game, far from it, but it's something visually interesting we can show you.

As we are moving closer to the testing phase and giving the game to other people, the menu is the first thing player sees when they start it up.

Our old menu was not changed for more than a year, it was full of empty screens and placeholders, since it was not a high priority during the development.

Bellow you can see how was the main menu screen looking before

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/46cec9043d82d850d689cb82feff36bcb2d569a2.jpg[/img]

and now the reworked menu page

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/452a562ecb89cb31280ef9c41e0c2ca7d2f832db.jpg[/img]

Following is the old page where player could choose which survival map to play

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/f144308dc0471eadf232596e3ce3837199073ef5.jpg[/img]

and the new version with additional info and improve art

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/709ef3fceb884569ec519fd36e4c88d84a2a879e.jpg[/img]

next we have the load game menu, which was a complete mess :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/5e797ebc419606ea341a11ac2740faf89895e84e.jpg[/img]

now its a clean and dedicated screen with all your save files

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/f944b5f31ed4962c43790f2a21843695ffccbed2.jpg[/img]

and lastly, we have a loading screen, which was really just an empty screen with simple status text

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/1edfec91ef1bc6833d690ccbc845f22f13a2a5ff.jpg[/img]

and we transformed it into a more informative page, giving you a loading progress bar, as well as cycling game tips, which can give you more hints and info about the game as you wait for your new world to generate

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/dc4237d65896e0c3b7158c0d3bbdc563b5a3af73.jpg[/img]

Martin, our artist, did an amazing job on designing the UI and we are really satisfied on how it turned out. There are still improvements we want to make to the menu in the future, as having a 3D animated scene from the game.

We hope you liked this new visual update!

See you in the next dev blog post, where we will talk about how the AI works in the game.

All the best,
Martin and Lukas from Play Square Games

notes.title: DevBlog #1 - Announcement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/a4236caf73cc4ccef7ea2b79ee41c874266c6917.png[/img]

Hello all! 

We are two indie developers, Lukas (me) and Martin, working on a Darfall game, where you build, defend, loot, explore and survive waves of undead invasions during the night.

This is the first dev blog, we hope one of many, where we introduce the game and ourselves to you.

I started this project several years back as a solo programmer. The original game was a player controlling this viking village, balancing its economy, all made using just 2D graphics.
The project later transformed into a 3D game, where you fought over a control of various islands inhabited by enemy factions :D
Later on, I removed the islands and just made one giant map where you built a city and defended against invasions. This was more or less the idea of the game we currently have. We then introduced some unique mechanics, like leveling and equipping a hero, crafting of items in your city, or a day & night cycle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/98702ae89a0a8ab2602a25bec55c67abf8380bba.png[/img]

A year ago, my artist friend Martin joined me in this endeavor. Martin did a great work on marketing, steam page, game trailer and the UI art. We also do a game design together, so you can imagine how two different mindsets have to work together and try to connect ideas into a single one (while still trying to stay friends :D)

You can watch the announcement trailer Martin made here:
[previewyoutube=FDdV5i5wb8k;full][/previewyoutube]

The project is done in a Unity engine, as this is the engine I've been working with for almost 10 years, both in hobby projects and professionally.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/0c9bf0f9adf1373fe75081d1ed9fa6eac306e3e9.jpg[/img]

Above you can see the entire map generated from the Unity editor view.

And this is where all the work is done from my side on the project
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/fccd67fa8c488f5d6e8c86282a61e6fb5cfa8578.jpg[/img]

And this is Martin's desk, you can see the creative notepad he uses for his sketches and ideas :D
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42663831/a93ed1d22eae2beb3a86c24ac26811279bc5daae.jpg[/img]

We hope you liked this brief introduction about us and the project :) Next dev blog post will be about the Main Menu rework we focused in the past week.

See you in the next blog post!

Martin and Lukas from Play Square Games
